title.en: How to adapt a novel into a game candidate
title.zh: 如何用 Novel to Game 把小说改编成游戏候选版本

answer.en: Start with a novel you own or are authorized to adapt, install the seven skills, and give the agent a small target experience. Lock the product brief before building, then ask for one complete runtime verification. A folder of design documents or a successful build alone is not a playable-game result.
answer.zh: 从你拥有或获准改编的小说开始，安装七个 skills，并给 Agent 一个范围较小的目标体验。构建前先锁定产品简报，之后要求一次完整的运行验证。只有设计文档，或只有构建成功，都不能算作游戏已经可玩。

en: A novel file, directory or link, plus an explicit rights/asset boundary. Do not treat access to a text as permission to adapt it.
A configured agent host. The installation table distinguishes Claude Code `/novel-to-game`, Codex `$novel-to-game` and Kimi Code `/skill:novel-to-game`; use the matching adapter.
An available engine and target runtime, or a documented plan for obtaining them. Model, media and tool services may require separate configuration or cost approval.
zh: 小说文件、目录或链接，以及明确的改编与素材使用边界。能访问文本不等于已经获准改编。
已配置的 Agent 宿主。安装表区分 Claude Code 的 `/novel-to-game`、Codex 的 `$novel-to-game` 与 Kimi Code 的 `/skill:novel-to-game`，请选择对应适配器。
可用的引擎和目标运行环境，或明确的准备计划。模型、媒体与工具服务可能需要另行配置或费用授权。

en: Install and choose a mode

Use the source README installation row for your host. `quick` recommends defaults and continues; `director` lets you choose the concept; `resume` reads the existing workspace and resumes from the earliest incomplete handoff.
Set the product brief

Ask for `PRODUCT_BRIEF.md`: scope, language, experience type, platform, engine, target runtime, tested runtime, input/display requirements, content limits and rights/asset boundaries. Ordinary assumptions can be recorded; material or safety-sensitive decisions require resolution.
Ground the adaptation

Review `analysis/SOURCE_BIBLE.md` for actual source evidence and `concepts/CONCEPT.md` for the chosen concept and trade-offs. If you want an interactive story, say so explicitly instead of letting a systems-game format be assumed.
Design and build a small candidate

Follow `design/GAME_DESIGN.md`, a risk-matched whitebox where needed, `design/ART_DIRECTION.md` and `build/BUILD_BRIEF.md`. Keep the first candidate small enough to exercise a complete loop rather than expanding its feature list.
Verify in the chosen runtime

Run the commands recorded in the build brief and collect launch, render, input, coreLoop, outcome and restart evidence from one complete run. A substitute runtime does not establish target-platform compatibility.
Resume honestly
Read `qa/verification.json`, evidence files and `_progress.md`. Fix the earliest failed handoff and rerun verification; do not convert missing tooling or untested behavior into PASS.
zh: 安装并选择模式
使用源码 README 中对应宿主的安装行。`quick` 推荐默认值并继续；`director` 让你选择概念；`resume` 读取现有工作区，从最早未完成的交接处恢复。
确定产品简报
要求建立 `PRODUCT_BRIEF.md`，明确范围、语言、体验类型、平台、引擎、目标运行环境、实际测试环境、输入与显示要求、内容尺度及权利/素材边界。普通假设可以记录；实质分支或安全敏感决策必须解决。
让改编有原文依据
检查 `analysis/SOURCE_BIBLE.md` 的原文证据，以及 `concepts/CONCEPT.md` 中选定的概念与取舍。想做互动故事时要明确说出，不要默认接受系统型游戏形式。
设计并构建小范围候选版本
依次依据 `design/GAME_DESIGN.md`、按需的风险匹配白盒、`design/ART_DIRECTION.md` 与 `build/BUILD_BRIEF.md` 推进。先把范围控制到能验证完整循环，而不是不断增加功能。
在选定环境中验证
运行构建简报记录的命令，用同一次完整运行收集 launch、render、input、coreLoop、outcome 和 restart 证据。替代运行环境通过不代表目标平台兼容。
如实恢复工作
读取 `qa/verification.json`、证据文件和 `_progress.md`，先修复最早失败的交接，再重新验证；工具缺失或行为未测试不能改写成 PASS。

example.en:
Terminal — install the Claude Code adapter:
npx skills add zenstory-ai/novel-to-game -g -y -a claude-code -s '*'

Then ask in Claude Code (replace the source path):
/novel-to-game quick
Use /ABS/my-authorized-novel.txt to create a small interactive-story candidate.
Draft PRODUCT_BRIEF.md first and record the target and tested runtimes.
Keep one complete loop, outcome and restart in scope.
Report missing tools and untested behavior rather than marking them PASS.
example.zh:
终端——安装 Claude Code 适配器：
npx skills add zenstory-ai/novel-to-game -g -y -a claude-code -s '*'

然后在 Claude Code 中请求（替换小说路径）：
/novel-to-game quick
用 /ABS/my-authorized-novel.txt 制作小范围的互动故事候选版本。
先写 PRODUCT_BRIEF.md，记录目标与实际测试运行环境。
范围内保留完整循环、设计结果和重开。
如实报告工具缺失或未测试行为，不把它们标为 PASS。

en: Scope: `PRODUCT_BRIEF.md`; source evidence: `analysis/SOURCE_BIBLE.md`; selected concept: `concepts/CONCEPT.md`.
Design: `design/GAME_DESIGN.md` and `design/ART_DIRECTION.md`; build instructions: `build/BUILD_BRIEF.md`; candidate: `build/app/`.
Runtime record: `qa/verification.json` plus its referenced evidence; progress and next handoff: `_progress.md`.
Before expanding branches, use the [meaningful-choice example](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/meaningful-choices) to turn one scene into actions, lasting state and distinct endings.
zh: 范围：`PRODUCT_BRIEF.md`；原文证据：`analysis/SOURCE_BIBLE.md`；选定概念：`concepts/CONCEPT.md`。
设计：`design/GAME_DESIGN.md` 与 `design/ART_DIRECTION.md`；构建说明：`build/BUILD_BRIEF.md`；候选产物：`build/app/`。
运行记录：`qa/verification.json` 及其引用的证据；进度与下一交接：`_progress.md`。
扩展分支前，可参照[有后果的选择示例](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/meaningful-choices)，把一个场景拆成行动、持久状态与不同结局。

en: The QA record uses `NOT_RUN`, `FAIL` or `PASS`. The six required checks are launch, render, input, coreLoop, outcome and restart; collect their evidence in one complete run rather than stitching unrelated partial successes together.
A PASS is limited to the recorded runtime, build and checked behavior. It does not certify fun, balance, commercial readiness or rights clearance.
Missing tools, provider access or an untested target remain explicit limitations. A validator fixture checks the record format; it is not evidence that your adaptation runs.
zh: QA 记录使用 `NOT_RUN`、`FAIL` 或 `PASS`。六项必检为 launch、render、input、coreLoop、outcome、restart；证据应来自同一次完整运行，不能拼接彼此无关的局部成功。
PASS 仅覆盖所记录的运行环境、构建与已检查行为，不认证趣味性、平衡性、商业发布准备程度或权利已清理。
工具、服务权限不足或目标环境未测试必须保留为明确限制。验证器样例只检查记录契约，不证明你的改编能够运行。

title.en: Export a video recap as an editable JianYing / CapCut draft
title.zh: 把视频解说导出为可编辑的剪映 / CapCut 草稿

answer.en: If Video Recap Skills has already produced `timeline.json`, run its standalone JianYing exporter to create a draft folder without rerunning ASR, visual understanding, TTS or MP4 rendering. Keep the media bundle with the draft, then check import and playback in your actual editor version. Exported JSON alone does not prove editor compatibility.
answer.zh: 如果 Video Recap Skills 已经生成 `timeline.json`，可以直接运行独立剪映导出器，创建草稿目录，无需重跑 ASR、视觉理解、TTS 或 MP4 渲染。让媒体包与草稿一起移动，再在你实际使用的编辑器版本中检查导入与播放。只导出 JSON 不证明编辑器兼容。

en: A local checkout or installed skill directory containing `skills/video-assemble/scripts/export_jianying.py`, Python, and a completed `timeline.json` with accessible media references. The `/ABS/` paths below are placeholders to replace. If you have not created a recap timeline yet, start with the [video-to-narration workflow](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/video-to-narration).

If starting before assembly, prepare the source video and `work_dir/tts_meta.json`. Local assembly needs ffmpeg; burned subtitles need its libass/subtitles filter. MiMo supplies remote ASR/VLM/default TTS; optional Fish Audio replaces TTS only.
A JianYing or CapCut desktop installation in which you can test the exported folder. Export is an optional sidecar; it is not required to render a recap MP4.
zh: 本地仓库或已安装的 skill 目录中存在 `skills/video-assemble/scripts/export_jianying.py`，有 Python、已生成的 `timeline.json`，且其媒体引用可访问。下方 `/ABS/` 路径是需要替换的占位符。 如果还没有解说时间线，先从[视频解说完整流程](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/video-to-narration)开始。
若尚未合成，先准备源视频与 `work_dir/tts_meta.json`。本地合成需要 ffmpeg；烧录字幕需要 libass/subtitles filter。MiMo 提供远程 ASR/VLM/默认 TTS；可选 Fish Audio 只替换 TTS。
能用于实际测试草稿的剪映或 CapCut 桌面安装。草稿是可选附加导出，不是渲染解说 MP4 的必要步骤。

en: Choose the entry point
For an existing `timeline.json`, use the standalone exporter below. If still assembling, pass `--export-jianying --jianying-out /ABS/drafts` to `assemble.py` after its required inputs are ready.
Preserve the right source

In cut mode, pass `--source-video /ABS/original.mp4` to the `assemble.py` command that creates `timeline.json`; this preserves real original-video intervals in the timeline. The standalone exporter then consumes that completed timeline and does not accept `--source-video`.
Export without remote stages
Run `export_jianying.py /ABS/work/timeline.json --out-dir /ABS/drafts --name recap_demo`. This path reads the timeline and media; it does not invoke MiMo/Fish or render a new MP4.
Keep the bundle together

Media bundling is on by default. Copy the whole output folder, including `Resources/local/`. Use standalone `--no-bundle-media` only if the editor can continue accessing the external media paths. Read warnings: missing media is not reported as successfully bundled.
Open in your target editor

Use your installed editor’s supported local-draft opening or import flow. Keep the returned draft directory intact and confirm its media, subtitles and audio tracks resolve; menus and draft locations vary by editor release.
Finish and play back
Adjust subtitles, framing and audio handoffs, then play the entire final export at normal speed. Automated QC identifies candidates for review; it is not proof that the finished video is correct.
zh: 选择入口
已有 `timeline.json` 时使用下方独立导出器。若仍在合成，待必要输入齐备后，在 `assemble.py` 命令中加入 `--export-jianying --jianying-out /ABS/drafts`。
保留正确源视频
cut 模式下，在生成 `timeline.json` 的 `assemble.py` 命令中传入 `--source-video /ABS/original.mp4`，让时间轴保留真实原片区间。之后独立导出器只读取这份已完成的时间轴，不接受 `--source-video` 参数。
不重跑远程阶段地导出
运行 `export_jianying.py /ABS/work/timeline.json --out-dir /ABS/drafts --name recap_demo`。这一路径读取时间轴与媒体，不调用 MiMo/Fish，也不渲染新的 MP4。
完整保留媒体包
默认开启媒体打包。移动时复制整个输出目录，包括 `Resources/local/`。只有编辑器仍能访问外部媒体路径时才使用独立导出器的 `--no-bundle-media`。注意读取警告：缺失媒体不会被记为已成功打包。
在目标编辑器中打开
使用已安装版本支持的本地草稿打开或导入方式，保持返回的草稿目录完整，并检查媒体、字幕和音轨是否可用；不同版本的菜单与草稿位置可能不同。
精修并完整播放
调整字幕、构图与声音交接，再以正常速度完整播放最终导出文件。自动 QC 只能定位待复核问题，不证明成片正确。

example.en:
From an existing timeline (replace every /ABS path):
python3 /ABS/video-recap-skills/skills/video-assemble/scripts/export_jianying.py \
  /ABS/work/timeline.json \
  --out-dir /ABS/drafts \
  --name recap_demo

Read the returned draft_dir and any warnings.
Keep the entire draft folder and its Resources/local/ media together.
example.zh:
从已有时间轴导出（替换所有 /ABS 路径）：
python3 /ABS/video-recap-skills/skills/video-assemble/scripts/export_jianying.py \
  /ABS/work/timeline.json \
  --out-dir /ABS/drafts \
  --name recap_demo

读取返回的 draft_dir 与全部警告。
把完整草稿目录与其中的 Resources/local/ 媒体一起保留。

en: The returned `draft_dir` contains `draft_content.json`, `draft_info.json` and `draft_meta_info.json`.
Bundled media goes under `Resources/local/video/`, `Resources/local/audio/` and `Resources/local/image/`; missing files remain explicit external references with warnings.
Non-empty output directories are not overwritten: export chooses a numbered sibling. This draft export is separate from the assembled MP4, subtitles and `timeline.json`.
zh: 返回的 `draft_dir` 包含 `draft_content.json`、`draft_info.json` 与 `draft_meta_info.json`。
打包媒体位于 `Resources/local/video/`、`Resources/local/audio/`、`Resources/local/image/`；缺失文件保留为带警告的外部引用。
不会覆盖非空输出目录，导出器会选择带编号的相邻目录。草稿导出与已合成的 MP4、字幕和 `timeline.json` 相互独立。

en: Confirm the three draft JSON files and referenced media, then test opening in the exact desktop/region version you intend to use. A schema template version or a historical smoke test is not universal CapCut/JianYing compatibility.

Check voiceover endings, audio sync, original-audio transitions, BGM levels, subtitle line breaks and cuts. Drafts reference source media, so hard subtitles already present in that footage can remain and may need masking.
An export-only smoke test validates the local draft contract, not a remote generation run, a successfully opened desktop editor or the final rendered video.
zh: 检查三份草稿 JSON 与引用媒体，再在实际目标桌面/地区版本中测试打开。Schema 模板版本或历史 smoke test 不等于所有剪映/CapCut 版本都兼容。
检查旁白尾字、音画同步、原声交接、BGM 音量、字幕断行与剪点。草稿引用源媒体，原素材已有的硬字幕可能仍在，需要时应遮罩。
只运行导出 smoke test 验证的是本地草稿契约，不证明已执行远程生成、桌面编辑器成功打开或最终成片正确。

title.en: Agent skills for writers: prompts, skill packs, plugins and MCP explained
title.zh: 不会编程也能用写作 Skill 吗？提示词、技能包、插件与 MCP 怎么分

answer.en: An agent skill packages task instructions and optional resources so a compatible AI agent can reuse a workflow. For a writer, that might mean turning an idea into an outline, importing an existing manuscript or revising a chapter against project notes—not writing software. Oh Story is a fiction-writing skill pack, not a new model or a standalone chat app. Start with the writing job you need done, then choose the host and workflow.
answer.zh: Agent Skill 把任务说明和可选的参考资料、脚本等打包，让兼容的 AI Agent 复用一套工作流程。对作者来说，任务可以是把灵感整理成细纲、导入已有小说，或结合项目设定修改章节，不一定是编程。Oh Story 是小说创作技能包，不是新模型，也不是独立聊天软件。先想清楚要完成哪项写作任务，再选运行环境与流程。

en: One concrete writing task and material you own or are authorized to use. A premise, a chapter needing revision or an unfinished manuscript is enough to choose a starting point.

For Oh Story, a configured supported agent host and a writing-project folder. You do not need to author code for the writing tasks below, but you do need to open the right folder, follow installation instructions and review requested file/tool access. If you prefer not to manage that setup, see the separate [hosted workbench](https://zenstory.ai/workbench).
zh: 一项具体写作任务，以及你拥有或获准使用的材料。一个故事点子、一章待修改的正文，或一部未完成的小说，都可以作为起点。
使用 Oh Story 需要先配置受支持的 Agent 宿主，并准备写作项目目录。下面的写作任务不要求你编写代码，但需要会打开正确的目录、按说明安装，并判断是否允许文件与工具操作。不想管理这套环境，可以了解独立的[托管写作工作台](https://zenstory.ai/workbench)。

en: Decide whether a prompt is enough

For “suggest five titles” or a one-off paragraph edit, a clear prompt may be all you need. Prompts can also be reusable templates. Consider a skill when you repeatedly paste the same process, refer to the same resources or need a consistent handoff between research, outlining and revision. Packaging makes the process reusable; it does not make every answer better.
Distinguish the instruction from the package

A skill has a SKILL.md entry with metadata and instructions, and may include references, templates or scripts. A compatible host discovers it and loads relevant instructions when needed. “Skill pack” is an informal name for a collection of related skills, not a separate object defined by the Agent Skills standard. Oh Story groups writing, import, analysis and revision tasks this way.
Separate the model, host, plugin and MCP connection

The model generates responses; the host runs the session and manages tools and permissions. In Claude Code, a plugin is a distribution container that can include skills, agents, hooks and MCP servers. MCP is a protocol for connecting AI applications to external data and tools, not a writing model or a synonym for a skill. These layers can work together; installing a skill does not train a new model.
Choose the entry by what you already have

Only an idea: use story-long-write to plan a long-form project, or story-short-write for a short story. Existing manuscript: follow the [import and continuation guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/import-and-continue) before asking for chapter 21, rather than starting from an empty project. A draft needing editorial feedback: use story-review; a passage needing less formulaic wording: use story-deslop and the [annotated prose revision example](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/revise-ai-prose). Unsure which to pick? Ask the story router to choose. Oh Story specializes in Chinese web-fiction workflows; its rubrics are not universal standards for all fiction.
Install one matching route, then work in your book folder

The [Oh Story project page](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story) shows the npx skills installation path. In Claude Code, that path uses /story-setup, followed by a fresh session and /story. The Claude Code marketplace plugin has namespaced commands such as /oh-story:story-setup instead. Follow the path you actually installed; other hosts can use different command syntax and may not support the same hooks or specialist agents.
Give a brief with a clear stopping point

Specify genre, reader experience, viewpoint, constraints and the deliverable. In the example below, the first request is for planning, not prose. Read the outline and resolve story choices, then request the first chapter explicitly. The example is a suggested brief, not output from a benchmark or a claim that a single prompt produces a finished novel.
Continue the project, not just the conversation

On the next session, return to the same writing folder and ask what is already established and what comes next. Point to the exact chapter or passage when requesting revisions. Keep author preferences separate from facts about this book, and ask the agent to update the relevant project records rather than only acknowledging a correction in chat. For DeepSeek Harness, use the separate [DSH writing guide](https://zenstory.ai/dsh/deepseek-novel-writing).
zh: 先判断一句提示词是否已经够用
只是“想五个书名”或临时修改一段文字，一条清楚的提示词往往就够了；提示词也可以保存成可复用模板。如果你反复粘贴同一套步骤、反复提供同一批参考资料，或需要让拆文、列纲、修订之间有固定交接，再考虑 skill。打包让流程可复用，不等于每次回答都会更好。
分清指令与技能包
一个 skill 以 SKILL.md 为入口，包含元数据和任务说明，也可以附参考资料、模板或脚本。兼容宿主发现它后，按需加载相关说明。“Skill pack / 技能包”通常是一组相关 skills 的非正式叫法，不是 Agent Skills 标准另外定义的对象。Oh Story 就把写作、导入、拆解、修订等任务组织成一组技能。
把模型、宿主、插件和 MCP 分开看
模型负责生成回答；宿主负责运行会话、管理工具与权限。在 Claude Code 中，plugin 是分发容器，可以一起装入 skills、agents、hooks 和 MCP servers。MCP 是让 AI 应用连接外部数据和工具的协议，不是写作模型，也不是 skill 的同义词。这些层可以配合使用；装一个 skill 并不等于训练了一个新模型。
按手头材料选择入口

只有点子：长篇用 story-long-write 规划，短篇用 story-short-write。已有小说：按[导入续写指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/import-and-continue)重建项目，而不是在空目录里直接要求写第 21 章。已有正文想听编辑意见：用 story-review；只想改掉某段的套话和机械表达：用 story-deslop，并参考[带修改理由的前后对照](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/revise-ai-prose)。不知道该选哪个，就让 story 路由判断。Oh Story 侧重中文网文流程，它的评审尺度不是所有小说的通用标准。
选一种匹配的安装方式，在自己的书稿目录里工作

[Oh Story 项目页](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story)提供 npx skills 安装方式。在 Claude Code 里，这条路径使用 /story-setup，完成后新开会话，再用 /story。Claude Code marketplace 插件则使用 /oh-story:story-setup 这样的命名空间命令。按实际安装路径使用命令，不要混用；其他宿主的语法以及 hooks、专用 agent 支持也可能不同。
交付要求写清楚，保留作者决策
说明题材、读者体验、视角、限制和交付物。下面的首次请求只要规划，不要正文。先读细纲、解决故事选择，再明确要求写第一章。示例是一份可改写的创作简报，不是模型实测产物，也不表示一句话就能得到可发表的整本小说。
续的是同一个项目，不只是同一段聊天
下次打开时，回到同一个写作目录，先询问已确定的内容与下一步。修订时指出具体章节或段落；把作者习惯与这本书的故事事实区分开，要求更新相关项目记录，而不是只在聊天里答应“记住了”。如果使用 DeepSeek Harness，接着看独立的[DSH 写作指南](https://zenstory.ai/dsh/deepseek-novel-writing)。

example.en:
In Claude Code, after the npx skills installation and /story-setup, open a fresh session in your writing folder. These are suggested requests, not recorded model output.

/story-long-write 帮我开书
Plan an original Chinese-language coastal mystery serial.
The protagonist repairs old radios and avoids confronting her family.
Use close third person. Clues must be observable; no supernatural solution.
First deliver the premise, character constraints, volume outline and first ten chapter outlines.
Stop before prose. List story decisions that need my input.

After reviewing and revising the plan:
/story-long-write 写第1章
Follow the agreed outline. Let the conflict emerge through dialogue and action.
Write only chapter 1, then summarize the changed project records.
example.zh:
在 Claude Code 中通过 npx skills 安装并完成 /story-setup 后，在写作目录新开会话。下面是建议请求，不是模型运行记录。

/story-long-write 帮我开书
规划一部原创的中文海港悬疑连载。
主角修理旧收音机，遇到家庭矛盾时习惯回避。
第三人称限知视角，线索必须可观察，不用超自然力量解谜。
先交付核心卖点、角色约束、卷纲和前十章细纲。
不要写正文；列出需要我决定的故事问题。

读完并修改规划后：
/story-long-write 写第1章
按已确认的细纲推进，用对话和行动呈现冲突。
只写第一章，最后说明本次更新了哪些项目记录。

en: Setup creates the host-specific skill/configuration files for the chosen installation. Those are the working environment, not the manuscript.
Planning produces book settings and outlines; an explicit chapter request produces prose. For an imported book, inspect the reconstructed project before asking for continuation.
Chapter continuity uses project records such as tracking state, not a promise that the model remembers every message. Preserve the writing folder and a backup of material you want to keep.

Once a chapter plan exists, use [outline to chapter](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/outline-to-chapter) to turn abstract plot labels into visible evidence, choices and consequences, without forcing a twist into every chapter.
zh: 环境部署生成所选宿主的技能与配置文件。这些是工作环境，不是书稿本身。
规划阶段交付设定与大纲，明确要求写章后才交付正文。已有小说导入后，先读重建的项目材料，再要求续写。
章节连续性依靠追踪状态等项目记录，不靠“模型记得每句话”的承诺。保留写作目录，并备份需要保存的材料。
已有章纲时，接着看[从章纲到章节](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/outline-to-chapter)：把剧情标签变成可见证据、选择与后果，不给每章硬塞反转。

en: Read for the intended scene, character choices and continuity before accepting a chapter. A completed workflow is not a guarantee of literary quality, detector scores or publication acceptance.
Review installation trust and model/service configuration separately. Open-source skills are not free model access, and files on your computer do not imply offline inference.
zh: 接纳一章前，先读场景是否成立、人物选择是否可信、前后事实是否一致。流程完成不保证文笔、检测器分数或投稿通过。
安装信任与模型、服务配置需要分别判断。开源技能不等于免费模型额度，文件放在本机也不等于推理离线。

title.en: Writing fiction with DeepSeek: choose chat, the DSH plugin or a workbench
title.zh: 用 DeepSeek 写小说：聊天、DSH 插件与工作台怎么选

answer.en: Choose by where the writing needs to live. Use an ordinary DeepSeek model chat for a disposable brainstorm, outline critique or scene rewrite that you will copy into your own manuscript. Use DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plus the community Oh Story DSH plugin when you want a local writing folder, persistent sessions, creation skills and a file/editor/Chat workbench. Use the separate hosted ZenStory service at app.zenstory.ai when you want an account-based browser project instead of running DSH locally. These are different layers: DeepSeek is the model/provider choice, DSH is the agent host, `@oh-story/dsh` is a community plugin for that host, and hosted ZenStory is a separate application. Installing the plugin does not add it to an ordinary DeepSeek chat, and this guide does not claim that hosted ZenStory natively uses DeepSeek. For the broader difference between chat, skills and agents, see [AI agent skills for writers](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers); for a field-by-field comparison of the three ZenStory AI writing environments, see [the workflow comparison](https://zenstory.ai/compare/writing-workflows).
answer.zh: 按作品需要保存在哪里来选。只想临时脑暴、点评大纲或改一段文字，并准备自己复制回稿件，用普通 DeepSeek 模型聊天即可；希望围绕本地写作目录持续创作，由会话、Skills 和文件/编辑器/Chat 工作台共同管理项目，可选 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）加社区插件 Oh Story DSH；不想在本地运行 DSH，而想用账户化的浏览器项目，则选独立的 ZenStory 托管服务 app.zenstory.ai。四者不是同一层：DeepSeek 是模型/Provider 选择，DSH 是 Agent 宿主，`@oh-story/dsh` 是装进该宿主的社区插件，ZenStory 托管版是另一套应用。安装插件不会把它装进普通 DeepSeek 聊天，本指南也不声称 ZenStory 托管版原生使用 DeepSeek。 若要先理解聊天、Skills 与 Agents 的通用差异，可阅读[写作者的 AI Agent Skills 指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers)；若要逐项比较 ZenStory AI 的三种写作环境，可查看[工作流对比](https://zenstory.ai/compare/writing-workflows)。

en: For ordinary chat, bring only the excerpt and constraints needed for that one task. Keep your own manuscript as the durable source; a chat answer is not automatically synchronized with a writing project.

For the local DSH route, use Node.js 24+ and a folder you are comfortable granting to the DSH workspace. The pinned installation below uses DSH `0.1.5-rc.1` and the community plugin `@oh-story/dsh@0.1.9`.

Configure a model/provider in DSH before asking it to generate text. The source supports adding a provider and API key under Settings → Models, or setting `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` before launch. DSH owns models, credentials, permissions and sessions; the plugin does not read those credentials.

For hosted ZenStory, use `https://app.zenstory.ai` as a separate account-based workflow. Do not expect a local DSH workspace, DSH plugin installation or ordinary DeepSeek chat history to appear there automatically.
zh: 使用普通聊天时，只带上这次任务所需的片段和约束，并由你自己保管权威稿件；聊天回答不会自动同步到写作项目。
使用本地 DSH 路线时，准备 Node.js 24+，以及一个愿意交给 DSH workspace 管理的作品目录。下方固定版本安装使用 DSH `0.1.5-rc.1` 与社区插件 `@oh-story/dsh@0.1.9`。
让 DSH 生成文本前先配置模型/Provider。源码说明可以在“设置 → 模型”中添加 Provider 和 API Key，或在启动前设置 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`。模型、凭据、权限和会话由 DSH 管理，插件不读取这些凭据。
ZenStory 托管版位于 `https://app.zenstory.ai`，属于独立的账户化流程。不要预期本地 DSH workspace、插件安装或普通 DeepSeek 聊天历史会自动出现在其中。

en: Pick the smallest environment that matches the job

For one question—three premise variants, feedback on a synopsis, or a rewrite of one supplied scene—ordinary chat keeps setup low. For an 80,000-word draft or a serial whose settings, chapter plans, prose and continuity must survive later sessions, consider DSH plus the plugin. If the manuscript should live in an account-based browser project and you do not want to run a local DSH process, use hosted ZenStory. If you already use another supported coding-agent host, follow the separate [agent-skills guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers) rather than assuming the DSH plugin installs there.
Install the community plugin in DSH Web

Run the versioned command in the example. It temporarily supplies pnpm because DSH's `plugin add` needs it, installs `@oh-story/dsh` into the `web` profile, and then starts DSH Web. Keep the terminal running. If a browser does not open, use the complete local URL printed by DSH; do not share its first-auth token.
Configure the model at the host layer

In DSH, add the provider and model under Settings → Models, or start DSH with `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` present when that is the provider you intend to use. This configuration belongs to DSH, not to the Oh Story plugin. Viewing existing work can be deferred without a model key, but generating new prose requires a configured model.
Open the writing folder before prompting

Use the plus button beside Workspaces, add the folder that should own the novel, choose that workspace and open a session. An empty folder initially stays in native DSH Chat. The novel workbench appears after recognized story files are created; a visible tab is a view of the same DSH workspace, not a second agent or a ZenStory account.
Start with a bounded book brief

Use `/story-long-write 帮我开书` (or the English intent in the example) and state genre, reader promise, protagonist, central pressure, length target, viewpoint, tone, hard exclusions and the desired stopping point. The bundled workflow's default opening path creates the project, core settings, volume outline and the first ten chapter blueprints, then stops before prose. Review the direction instead of asking for an entire novel in one turn.
Write one chapter and inspect the files

After approving the setup, explicitly request `/story-long-write 写第1章`. Check the actual file under `正文/`, its matching file under `大纲/`, and the relevant settings rather than judging only the chat summary. Give corrections as concrete constraints—what fact, voice, reveal boundary or ending beat must change—then request a revision of the named chapter.
Continue from the persistent workspace

On a later visit, reopen the same DSH workspace and an existing or new session, then ask `/story` to inspect the current project before continuing. Name the next scope, such as one chapter, and tell it not to replace manual edits. The long-writing workflow distinguishes a named chapter, daily continuation and revision; a bare command diagnoses project state instead of silently producing chapters. Back up the manuscript folder separately from host/profile configuration.
zh: 按任务选择最小够用的环境

只问一个问题——例如给出三个梗概、点评简介或改写你提供的一场戏——普通聊天准备最少。已有八万字稿件，或需要让设定、逐章细纲、正文与连续性状态跨会话保留的连载，可选 DSH 加插件。希望稿件位于账户化网页项目、又不想在本地运行 DSH，则用 ZenStory 托管版。若本来就在其他受支持的 coding-agent 宿主里工作，请按单独的 [Agent Skills 指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers)选择，不要假设 DSH 插件也能直接装进去。
在 DSH Web 中安装社区插件
运行示例中的固定版本命令。命令临时提供 pnpm，因为 DSH 的 `plugin add` 会用到它；随后把 `@oh-story/dsh` 装入 `web` profile，并启动 DSH Web。终端需要保持运行。浏览器没有自动打开时，使用 DSH 在终端打印的完整本地地址，但不要分享其中用于首次认证的 token。
在宿主层配置模型
在 DSH 的“设置 → 模型”中添加 Provider 和模型；如果准备使用对应的 DeepSeek Provider，也可以在启动 DSH 前提供 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`。这是 DSH 的配置，不是 Oh Story 插件的配置。查看已有作品可以稍后再配模型，但生成新文本需要可用的模型配置。
先打开作品目录，再发写作请求
点击 Workspaces 旁的加号，添加真正存放小说的目录，选中 workspace 并打开会话。空目录起初仍显示 DSH 原生 Chat；Agent 写出可识别的小说文件后，小说工作台才会出现。这个标签只是同一 DSH workspace 的视图，不是第二个 Agent，也不是 ZenStory 账户。
用有边界的开书请求起步
输入 `/story-long-write 帮我开书`，并写清题材、读者承诺、主角、核心压力、预计篇幅、视角、语气、明确禁区和本轮停靠点。内置流程默认先建立项目、核心设定、卷纲与首批十章细纲，然后停在正文前。先审方向，不要一轮要求生成整本小说。
明确写一章，并检查真实文件
确认设定和细纲后，再明确输入 `/story-long-write 写第1章`。检查 `正文/` 中的实际章节、`大纲/` 中对应细纲及相关设定，不要只看 Chat 摘要。修改意见要落到可执行约束：哪个事实、人物声音、信息揭示边界或章尾节拍需要变化，然后点名要求修改该章。
从持久化 workspace 继续
下次打开同一 DSH workspace，进入已有或新会话，先让 `/story` 检查当前项目再继续。明确本轮只写下一章等范围，并要求保留人工修改。长篇流程会区分指定章节、日更续写与回炉修改；裸命令只诊断项目状态，不会悄悄批量写正文。备份时应把稿件目录与宿主/profile 配置分别保管。

example.en:
Suggested input — original example, not an observed model answer:

Terminal — install the pinned plugin and start DSH Web:
npx -y --package pnpm@11.7.0 --package @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1 dsh plugin --profile web add @oh-story/dsh@0.1.9 &&
npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1 web

In the DSH session for your chosen empty workspace:
/story-long-write 帮我开书
Create a 240,000-word near-future mystery serial for adult readers.
Premise: a municipal archivist discovers that one ordinary resident disappears from every public record at 02:17 each night, but her handwritten corrections return by morning.
Reader promise: procedural investigation plus the cost of deciding which version of a person deserves to survive.
Protagonist: meticulous, conflict-averse, and personally implicated by a missing sibling.
Use close third person, restrained prose, and no omniscient explanation of the system in the opening volume.
For this turn, create the project settings, volume outline and first ten chapter blueprints only. Stop before prose and list the files created.

After reviewing the plan:
/story-long-write 写第1章
Use the approved chapter blueprint. Write only chapter 1, preserve the reveal boundary, and end when the protagonist sees her own correction handwriting in a file she has never opened. Save the prose in the project; do not continue to chapter 2.

In a later session in the same workspace:
/story Please inspect the current novel files and continuity state first. Continue with only the next planned chapter. Preserve my manual edits to chapter 1, report any missing or conflicting blueprint before writing, and summarize the files changed when done.
example.zh:
建议输入——以下为原创示例，不是实测模型回答：

终端——安装固定版本插件并启动 DSH Web：
npx -y --package pnpm@11.7.0 --package @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1 dsh plugin --profile web add @oh-story/dsh@0.1.9 &&
npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1 web

在你选定的空 workspace 对应 DSH 会话中输入：
/story-long-write 帮我开书
写一部约 24 万字、面向成年读者的近未来悬疑连载。
核心梗：市档案员发现，每晚 02:17 都有一名普通居民从全部公共记录中消失，但她手写的修订次日又会恢复。
读者承诺：程序化调查，以及“哪个版本的人值得留下”带来的选择代价。
主角：严谨、回避冲突，并因失踪的手足与事件有私人关联。
使用第三人称限知和克制文风；第一卷不得全知解释系统真相。
本轮只建立项目设定、卷纲和首批十章细纲，停在正文前，并列出创建的文件。

检查并确认计划后输入：
/story-long-write 写第1章
严格使用已确认的本章细纲，只写第 1 章，保留信息揭示边界；在主角发现一份从未打开的档案里出现了自己的修订笔迹时收尾。正文写入项目文件，不要继续第 2 章。

以后在同一 workspace 的会话中输入：
/story 请先检查当前小说文件和连续性状态，再只续写计划中的下一章。保留我对第 1 章的人工修改；如果细纲缺失或冲突，先报告，不要猜写。完成后说明改动了哪些文件。

en: After the default book-opening pass, expect creator-readable files for positioning and relationships under `设定/`, a book and volume outline plus per-chapter blueprints under `大纲/`, and initialized continuity state under `追踪/`. The bundled workflow says the first pass normally stops after the first ten chapter blueprints.

After an explicit chapter request, prose is written by chapter under `正文/` (for example `正文/第001章_章名.md`) and the continuity views are updated through the writing workflow. The manuscript file, not a celebratory chat message, is the deliverable to review.

The DSH novel workbench presents the same project as a file tree, editor and Chat. Hosted ZenStory also uses a browser workbench, but it is a separate account/application boundary; neither surface name proves that the same plugin, model or project files are underneath.
zh: 默认开书完成后，通常会得到 `设定/` 下供作者阅读的题材定位与关系等文件，`大纲/` 下的全书/卷级大纲和逐章细纲，以及 `追踪/` 下初始化的连续性状态。内置流程说明第一轮默认停在首批十章细纲之后。
明确请求写章后，正文按章写入 `正文/`（例如 `正文/第001章_章名.md`），连续性视图也由写作流程更新。需要审的是稿件文件，而不是 Chat 中一句“已经完成”。
DSH 小说工作台用文件树、编辑器和 Chat 呈现同一项目。ZenStory 托管版也有浏览器工作台，但它属于独立账户与应用边界；界面都叫工作台，不代表底层使用同一插件、模型或项目文件。

en: Before continuing, open the files named in the completion message and confirm that the premise, viewpoint, exclusions, reveal boundary and chapter stopping point are actually present. A workbench tab or a fluent answer alone is not proof that the project was updated.
Reopen the same workspace in a later session and ask for a project-state diagnosis before generation. Confirm the last completed chapter and next blueprint, then request only the scope you want.

Treat model output as a draft: review continuity, copied or unsupported material, factual claims and publication rights yourself. This guide compares workflows, not measured writing quality or a guarantee of publishable fiction.
zh: 继续前，打开完成消息中点名的文件，确认核心梗、视角、禁区、信息揭示边界与本章停笔点确实落在项目里。只看到工作台标签或一段流畅回答，不能证明项目已更新。
之后换会话时重新打开同一 workspace，先要求诊断项目状态。核对最后完成章节与下一章细纲，再明确只生成你要的范围。
把模型输出当作草稿：连续性、可能复用或缺乏依据的内容、事实与发表权利都需要作者自行复核。本指南比较工作流，不代表实测写作质量，也不保证直接可发表。

title.en: Continue an unfinished novel with AI: import 10–20 chapters into Oh Story
title.zh: 已有 10–20 章怎么让 AI 接着写：导入 Oh Story，接续人物设定与前史

answer.en: If you already have 10–20 chapters, do not ask an empty chat to ‘continue in the same style.’ Use story-import to reconstruct the manuscript as an Oh Story writing project, review its inferences, then request the next chapter. Import preserves the source prose while building settings, outlines and continuity records. It cannot recover unwritten intent, guarantee a perfect voice match or settle every ambiguity; the manuscript remains the evidence.
answer.zh: 已经写了 10–20 章，不要在空白聊天里只说“照这个风格续写”。先用 story-import 把书稿重建成 Oh Story 写作工程，审阅反推结果，再点名写下一章。导入会保留原文，同时建立设定、大纲与连贯性记录；它不能恢复未写进正文的意图，也不保证无损复刻文风或补对所有歧义。书稿证据始终优先于模型猜测。

en: Back up material you own or may use. Documented direct inputs are one .txt/.md file, a directory of chapter files, or pasted text; direct .docx, EPUB and PDF import is not documented.

Open a supported agent host in the writing workspace. New to skills or hosts? Read [Agent skills for writers](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers). Commands below follow Claude Code’s npx skills path; other hosts and the marketplace plugin can differ.
Identify the last complete chapter. Keep a half-written ending marked as a partial draft so unfinished events do not become established facts.
zh: 先备份你拥有或获准使用的书稿。当前明确支持单个 .txt/.md、章节文件目录或直接粘贴文本；流程没有声明可直接导入 .docx、EPUB 或 PDF。
在写作工作区打开受支持的 Agent 宿主。若还分不清 skill 与宿主，先看[写作者的 Agent Skill 入门](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers)。下文按 Claude Code 的 npx skills 路径书写，其他宿主或 marketplace 插件的语法可能不同。
确认最后一个完整章号。把只写一半的末章明确标成残稿，避免其中尚未完成的动作被登记为事实。

en: Choose import, not deconstruction

Use story-import for a continuable project: settings, outlines, normalized prose and tracking. Use story-long-analyze only for a deconstruction library and report. Import analyzes your manuscript, but that analysis is a data source, not the deliverable or an external comparison title. If you only want to learn how a passage works, the [fiction-analysis guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/learn-from-fiction) shows an evidence-to-mechanism reading exercise without starting an import.
Prepare a clean source boundary

Use one .txt/.md file, a directory with sortable chapter filenames, or pasted text. Exclude advertisements, author notes and alternate drafts unless they are evidence. State the title, genre, platform, completion status and last complete chapter. Confirm the detected chapter range and long/short classification.
Set up first, then import

For Claude Code’s npx path, run /story-setup in the workspace, refresh the session, then run /story-import and provide the path. Direct import is allowed, but missing project infrastructure can mean setup first or a serial fallback. Do not mix this spelling with namespaced marketplace-plugin commands.
Keep author decisions with the author

Confirm continuable project versus analysis only, the last complete chapter, and treatment of a partial ending. If the text has no volume markers, review candidate divisions before volume outlines are finalized. Unsupported fields should stay [待补充] or become continuity risks—not confident-looking filler.
Review the reconstructed handoff

Confirm 正文/ has every expected chapter and unchanged prose. Then inspect 设定/角色/, 大纲/ and 追踪/上下文.md. Current identities, locations, goals, relationships, knowledge, unresolved threads and the next-chapter promise must match evidence through the last complete chapter. Separate author-only truth from character and reader knowledge.
Restore intent, then request prose

Resolve important [待补充] items or leave them uncertain. State the ending to carry forward, viewpoint and voice constraints, facts not yet revealable, and the next chapter’s job. Correct the plan first if reconstruction points the story the wrong way. This restores intentions that prose could not reveal.
Name the next chapter and keep one authority

From the imported book directory, use /story-long-write 写第21章 (replace 21 with N+1) or a scoped daily request. A bare command only diagnoses the project. Revise an old chapter through its revision route; do not hand-edit derived tracking views. A current project with 追踪/_tracking-state.json normally continues without full re-import. If you expand the imported source range, the documented path is another full import rather than appending history to old snapshots. Back up any work added since the first import before rebuilding.
zh: 先选导入续写，不要只做拆文

要得到可续写的设定、大纲、正文与追踪状态，就用 story-import；只要拆解资料和报告，才用 story-long-analyze。导入会分析书稿，但拆文库是重建数据源，不是最终工程，也不会把自己的书自动登记成外部对标。 如果只想学一段文字为什么起作用，[小说拆文指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/learn-from-fiction)提供从证据到机制的精读练习，不必启动导入。
把导入范围整理干净
使用一个 .txt/.md、文件名可排序的章节目录，或直接粘贴文本。广告、作者的话和不同版本草稿若不是故事证据，就移出导入集。说明书名、题材、平台、完本状态与最后完整章，并确认系统识别的章节范围和长短篇分类。
先部署环境，再导入
按 Claude Code 的 npx 路径，在工作区运行 /story-setup，刷新会话，再运行 /story-import 并提供路径。直接 import 也可以，但基础设施缺失时会选择先 setup 或串行降级。不要与 marketplace 插件的命名空间命令混用。
作者决定不能外包
确认目标是可续写工程还是仅分析、最后完整章号，以及残稿如何处理。原文没有卷标时，先审阅候选卷界，再定卷纲。正文无法证明的字段保留 [待补充] 或写入连贯性风险，不为表格整齐而补猜。
正文前先审阅交接状态
确认 正文/ 章节齐全且原文未被改写；再看 设定/角色/、大纲/ 和 追踪/上下文.md。人物身份、位置、目标、关系、本人已知、未结事项与下一章承诺，都要能由最后完整章以前的内容证明，并分开作者真相、角色认知与读者已知。
补回作者意图，再要正文
解决关键 [待补充]，或明确保留为未知。说明上一章结尾怎么承接、视角与语言习惯、暂不能揭露的事实，以及下一章任务。正文从未呈现的意图由你补回；若反推规划方向错了，先修规划，不要硬续。
点名下一章，只保留一个权威工程
进入导入后的书名目录，用 /story-long-write 写第21章（把 21 换成 N+1），或给出范围清楚的日更请求。裸调用只诊断状态。旧章变化影响连续性时走大修流程，不要手改派生追踪视图。已有 追踪/_tracking-state.json 的项目通常直接续写；扩大原文导入范围时，文档要求重新完整导入，而不是向旧快照追加历史；重建前先另存备份，保留首次导入后新增的工作。

example.en:
Suggested requests—not recorded or tested model output. Assume chapters 1–20 are complete and chapter 21 is a separate partial draft.

/story-import
Import /Users/me/novels/harbor-radio/complete-chapters.md as a continuable long-form project. Chapters 1–20 are complete; do not treat the chapter-21 fragment as fact. Preserve the prose. Before migration, show the detected range, unresolved facts and candidate volume boundaries.

After reviewing the project:

/story-long-write 写第21章
Continue chapter 20’s final scene in close third person on Lin Zhou. Keep the restrained dialogue rhythm. The reader knows about the red notebook; Chen Yu does not. Do not reveal who changed the broadcast log. Make Lin Zhou choose whether to repair the receiver before the tide returns. Write only chapter 21 and report changed project records.
example.zh:
以下是建议请求，不是已记录或已测试的模型输出。假设第 1–20 章完整，第 21 章残稿另存。

/story-import
把 /Users/me/novels/海港收音机/完整章节.md 导入为可续写长篇工程。第 1–20 章完整；第 21 章残稿暂不视为事实。保留原文。迁移前展示章节范围、待确认事实和候选卷界。

审阅工程后：

/story-long-write 写第21章
承接第 20 章最后场景，继续林舟的第三人称限知视角，保持克制的对话节奏。读者知道红色笔记本，陈雨不知道；不要揭示谁改了广播日志。本章让林舟在涨潮前决定是否修接收机。只写第 21 章，并说明更新了哪些项目记录。

en: 拆文库/{book}/ retains the source backup and reconstruction analysis; it is not the continuable project by itself.
A long-form project puts preserved prose in 正文/, reconstructed settings in 设定/, outlines in 大纲/, and continuity state in 追踪/.
追踪/_tracking-state.json is authoritative. Context, character, foreshadowing and timeline Markdown are generated views; continuation begins after the last complete imported chapter.

For ongoing chapters after import, use the [long-novel continuity example](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/long-novel-continuity): separate author truth, character/reader knowledge, unresolved promises and future plans before drafting.
zh: 拆文库/{书名}/ 保存原文备份与重建分析；它本身不是可续写工程。
长篇工程把保留的正文放在 正文/，反推设定放在 设定/，大纲放在 大纲/，连贯性状态放在 追踪/。
追踪/_tracking-state.json 是权威状态；上下文、角色、伏笔和时间线 Markdown 是派生视图。续写从最后完整导入章之后开始。
导入后持续写章，可接着看[长篇连续性示例](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/long-novel-continuity)：写前分开作者真相、角色/读者认知、未完承诺与未来计划。

en: Before chapter N+1, compare the final scene, active characters’ locations and knowledge, unresolved promises and reader-visible facts with the manuscript. Correct unsupported inferences or keep them uncertain.

Read the first continuation beside the last two original chapters for voice, viewpoint, knowledge boundaries and causal handoff. Revise old chapters through the workflow, not by patching generated tracking files.
zh: 写第 N+1 章前，把最后场景、活跃角色的位置与已知、未结承诺、读者可见事实对回书稿。无证据推断要纠正或保留为未知。
把第一章续写与最后两章原稿并读，检查文风、视角、认知边界和因果承接。旧章需要修改时走大修流程，不手补派生追踪文件。

title.en: Adapt a novel into a short drama: episodes, scripts and storyboards
title.zh: 用 AI 把小说改成短剧：分集、剧本与分镜怎么衔接

answer.en: Start with the source story and the decisions an adaptation may change—not a request to turn every chapter into an episode. Drama Skills can help analyze the source, plan episode handoffs, write a pilot and develop its visual specifications and storyboard. It is an open-source agent skill suite, not a one-click finished-video service. This guide stops at a text handoff and uses an original editorial example to show how prose becomes visible action.
answer.zh: 从原著和允许改动的范围开始，而不是直接要求“每章变一集”。Drama Skills 可以辅助原著分析、分集交接规划、试写一集，以及视觉设定和分镜设计。它是开源 Agent 技能合集，不是一键交付成片的视频服务。本指南止步于文本交付，并用一个原创编剧示例说明：怎样把小说文字变成观众看得见的行动。

en: Source material you own or are authorized to adapt, in a form the host can read. Select a coherent source segment for the first pass; tell the agent which characters, facts, themes and ending promises must remain.

A target form and a manageable first deliverable. For example, ask for a three-episode plan and only the first episode’s script. Choose the intended duration, audience and live-action or motion-comic form; these are project choices, not platform-wide requirements.

A configured supported agent host and a project folder. For the documented Claude Code route, ask “Install this skill suite: https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills”, review the proposed setup, then use /short-drama. See the [project page](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills) for the suite and the [writer’s skill guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers) for host terminology.
zh: 准备你拥有或获准改编、且宿主能够读取的源材料。首次选一段相对完整的故事，说明哪些角色、事实、主题与结局承诺不能改。
给出目标形态和范围可控的首次交付，例如先规划三集，只写第一集剧本。单集时长、受众以及实拍短剧或漫剧形态由项目选择，并非所有平台的统一要求。

准备已配置的受支持 Agent 宿主与项目目录。按文档中的 Claude Code 路径，可先请求“Install this skill suite: https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills”，审阅安装方案后使用 /short-drama。[项目页](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills)介绍技能合集；不熟悉宿主等概念，可先读[作者 Skill 指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers)。

en: Separate source facts from adaptation decisions

Ask the agent to retain source locations, established facts, allowed changes and unresolved questions. Identify what already works on screen, what needs an observable carrier such as an action or prop, and what exists only as prose. Original ideas can be developed too, but proposed additions must not be attributed to a novel that never contained them. If you have not yet decided whether the novel is suitable, start with short-drama-novel-analyze for a source triage; use short-drama-develop to develop the chosen adaptation direction.
Cut episodes around dramatic results, not chapter numbers

Use an [episode map](https://zenstory.ai/glossary/fenji-ditu): incoming state, immediate goal, opposition, turn, local result and the pressure inherited by the next episode. A long chapter may support several episodes; several chapters may serve one dramatic result. Preserve causality when compressing or reordering events. If the selected source cannot support the requested count without invention, surface that choice rather than padding. Below, wiping the inscription, being hurried and reading the signature do not automatically become three episodes. A candidate three-episode map uses explicitly added premises, gives each episode a local payoff and prevents the next one from rediscovering the same fact as a new twist.
Write one pilot before scaling the series

Ask for the first episode’s screenplay from the accepted map. Replace important internal reasoning with actions, dialogue, evidence or a visual/sound cue the audience can understand. Do not simply read the novel aloud over images. Review who wants what, what changes in the scene and why the final beat creates a real next question; then apply those decisions to later episodes.
Record reusable visual facts

Define recurring characters, locations and props before relying on them across shots. For the example below, the oil-stained left sleeve, damaged clock corner and position of the consignment slip are continuity facts; “make it cinematic” is not. If a director’s statement is proposed, accept the intended visual direction before treating it as binding. Optional look exploration does not require commissioning images.
Turn the accepted scene into a storyboard

Each shot should have a purpose, a source in the screenplay, duration, visible action and start/end states. A [frozen keyframe](https://zenstory.ai/glossary/dongjie-guanjianzhen) describes a boundary frame, normally the shot’s start; it is not the whole movement and not an already-created picture. Distinguish a planned reference from an actual image that has been inspected and bound for use.
Keep text handoff separate from media production

Deliver the requested screenplay, visual specification and storyboard first; add image/video prompts only when needed. If you later commission media, choose available providers and review the actual assets and scope. The documented production flow prepares a preview and requires explicit confirmation before running external generation. A local skill installation is not a promise of free or offline model work.
zh: 先把原文事实与改编决定分开
要求保留来源位置、已成立的事实、可改范围和待确认问题。分清哪些内容已经能直接拍，哪些需要动作、道具等可见载体，哪些只存在于小说叙述中。原创点子也能开发，但新增设定必须标为改编选择，不能说成原著里本来就有。 还没决定这本小说是否适合改编，可以先让 short-drama-novel-analyze 做原著快评；确定方向后，再由 short-drama-develop 推进开发。
按戏剧结果切集，不按章节号平均分

使用[分集地图](https://zenstory.ai/glossary/fenji-ditu)，记录进入状态、当前目标、阻力、转折、局部结果和下一集继承的压力。一章可以支持多集，几章也可能共同完成一个戏剧结果；压缩或调整事件顺序时，要保住因果。如果所选原文不足以支撑目标集数，应明确提出取舍，而不是灌水或悄悄编造。 下方先展示为什么“擦字、催促、看签名”不是天然的三集，再用明确标出的新增设定，给出三集候选地图。每集写清已经兑现的结果，下一集不得把同一个发现重新当作反转。
先写一集，再扩展整季
根据已接受的分集地图，只写第一集剧本。把关键心理活动换成观众能够理解的动作、对白、证据或视听线索，不要只是给小说朗读配图。先读清楚“谁想要什么、场内改变了什么、最后一拍为什么留下真正的新问题”，再把确认后的创作决定带到后续各集。
先记录能复用的视觉事实
跨镜头反复出现的角色、场景和道具，需要明确可见规格。以下示例中，左袖油渍、座钟缺角、委托单位置是连续性事实；“拍得有电影感”不是。如果提出导演阐述，先由创作者接受视觉方向，再把它作为下游约束；可选的画风探索不要求立刻付费生成图片。
从已接受的场次拆分镜
每个镜头都应有职责、剧本来源、时长、可见动作和起止状态。[冻结关键帧](https://zenstory.ai/glossary/dongjie-guanjianzhen)描述一个边界画面，默认是镜头起点，不代表整个运动过程，更不代表图片已经存在。未来计划使用的参考与已经检查、绑定的真实图片，要分开记录。
把文本交付与媒体制作分开
先交付所需的剧本、视觉设定和分镜，确实需要时再加图片、视频提示词。以后决定制作媒体时，再选择可用供应商、检查实际素材和执行范围。文档规定外部生成先准备预览、再明确确认、最后运行。技能装在本地，不代表模型工作免费或离线。

example.en:
Suggested request in Claude Code after setup (replace the path):
/short-drama
Use /ABS/my-authorized-story.txt for a short-drama adaptation.
First identify source facts, proposed changes and open questions.
Plan the first three episodes for a 60–90 second target each; explain if the source needs a different split.
Keep the protagonist’s motivation and the agreed ending. Do not add a hidden villain as an established source fact.
Write only episode 1 after I accept the map. Then develop that episode’s visual facts and storyboard when requested.
Stop at text files. Do not generate images, video, voices or music.

ORIGINAL EDITORIAL EXAMPLE — written for this guide, not tool output or a timed film.
Source fragment:
When an auction-house courier arrived to collect a repaired clock, Shen Ning recognized her father’s handwriting underneath it. She believed he would never have sold it. The courier needed her handover signature for an auction starting in twenty minutes; the consignment slip carried her mother’s signature.

Adaptation choice:
Keep the handwriting, deadline and signature. Replace the long internal doubt with an inspection she can perform in front of the courier. The invented sleeve/clock details below are staging choices, not extra source facts.

Scene excerpt:
INT. REPAIR SHOP — EVENING
Shen turns the clock over and rubs dust from the inscription with her left sleeve.
SHEN: He wrote that last character backwards. Every time.
COURIER: Twenty minutes. I need your signature.
He slides a slip onto the right side of the workbench.
Shen reaches for the pen, sees the consignor’s signature and stops.
SHEN: My mother sent this?

Four-shot handoff excerpt (not a full episode or a production-ready storyboard):
01 — Clock underside: dusty writing partly visible; sleeve wipes it clean. Reveal the recognizable clue.
02 — Two-shot: Shen holds the clock; courier checks the time. Establish the opposing deadline.
03 — Slip insert: paper arrives on the right of the bench; a finger stops beside the signature. Reveal the new fact.
04 — Shen’s reaction: pen held above paper; her gaze lifts to the courier. End on the question, not a generic shocked face.

Continuity notes: oil stain on Shen’s left sleeve; clock missing its upper-right ornament; slip stays to the right of the clock. No reference images have been generated or bound.

From the four-shot excerpt to a candidate three-episode map
Do not assume “EP001 wipes the inscription → EP002 the courier hurries her → EP003 she sees the signature” already makes three episodes. Those actions may serve one scene, but do not yet supply three distinct choices and consequences. The short source can first become one scene; there is no need to repeat the demand for a signature, invent a villain or interrupt a sentence just to reach three episodes.

For a different structure, this guide adds the following original adaptation premises. They are not facts established by the source excerpt. In a real adaptation, have the author accept the added direction first:
A. Her mother personally signed the consignment form and intends to put any auction proceeds toward rent for a community repair class. No sale or payment has occurred, and nothing establishes this as her father's final wish.
B. Shen Ning wants to keep an object associated with her father but cannot currently offer replacement rent money. Her problem is how to preserve a memory, not how to find another convenient signature mistake.
C. The courier can wait one extra minute while she photographs the inscription; that does not give him authority to stop the auction. Her mother can answer a call. Time advances continuously across the episodes; the twenty-minute countdown does not reset each time.

EP001 | Recognition is not an answer
Entry: the clock is in the repair shop, and Shen Ning has not signed the handover form. She recognizes the inscription while the courier hurries her.
Goal and action: establish where the clock came from before handing it over. She asks to inspect the consignment form.
Turn and local payoff: the form names her mother. There is now a specific person to ask, but the signature alone cannot explain a motive and has not yet been confirmed by its signer.
Exit → EP002: Shen Ning takes out her phone and calls her mother. The clock and unsigned handover form remain in the shop. Neither Shen Ning nor the audience knows why it was consigned. The next episode starts with her mother answering, not another discovery of the same name.

EP002 | Keeping it also has a cost
Entry: the clock has not been handed over, the handover form is unsigned, and the call is awaiting an answer.
Goal and action: Shen Ning wants her mother to withdraw the consignment. Her mother confirms signing it herself and explains her plan for the class rent. Shen Ning proposes keeping the clock but cannot say where replacement funds would come from.
Turn and local payoff: the mother's account rules out a mistaken delivery or signature. The conflict becomes a choice between keeping the object and supporting the class. The audience now knows her mother's plan, not what her father would have wanted.
Exit → EP003: Shen Ning stops disputing the paperwork. She ends the call and asks for one minute to photograph the inscription; the courier agrees. The clock has not left, and her final choice remains open. Episode three must not make her forget the rent plan or treat an unknown sale price as settled money.

EP003 | What leaves, what stays
Entry: the clock is still in the shop, the handover is unsigned, and the agreed minute has begun. Shen Ning knows her mother's plan.
Choice and action: she photographs the inscription, sends the photograph to her mother, signs the handover form and gives the courier the clock. After the handover, she tells her mother the clock has gone with the courier and asks that they discuss such old belongings together in future; her mother replies in agreement.
Local payoff: the object leaves, the inscription has a record, and mother and daughter make a specific new agreement. This settles how Shen Ning acts on this occasion, not all of her sadness.
Final state: the courier has the clock; Shen Ning has the photograph; her mother knows she has released it. The auction result, actual proceeds and whether the class goes ahead have not happened. If the story continues, those are later tasks—not a reason to add an unrelated abduction for a cliffhanger.

Keep three episodes or combine them?
Remove EP002 and Shen Ning jumps from questioning a signature to releasing the clock without the information that changes her judgment. Remove EP003 and the story explains a plan but omits the decision's consequence. This shows why the state changes matter, not why they must occupy three episodes. If the intended duration, performance space or material does not support three, combine the confirmation and decision rather than repeating dialogue. This map is not a complete script, a timed 60–90-second episode or a filmed result.

Add this scope to the earlier request:
Before writing the script, propose one-episode and three-episode cuts with their tradeoffs. For each episode, list entry facts, choice and local result, what the audience newly learns, and what the next episode must inherit. Separate source facts from proposed additions; do not decide missing motives for me. Once I accept the structure and added premises, write only EP001 and stop at text.
example.zh:
在 Claude Code 完成安装后，可这样请求（替换路径）：
/short-drama
用 /ABS/我有权改编的故事.txt 开发短剧。
先区分原文事实、拟改内容和待确认问题。
先规划前三集，每集目标 60–90 秒；如果原文更适合其他切法，说明理由。
保留主角动机和已约定的结局，不把新增幕后反派写成原著事实。
我接受分集地图后，只写第一集剧本；之后按请求补该集视觉事实与分镜。
止步于文本文件，不生成图片、视频、配音或音乐。

原创编剧示例——为本指南编写，不是工具实测输出，也不是已计时成片。
源故事片段：
拍卖行的取件员来到维修铺，要取回修好的旧座钟。沈宁在钟底认出了父亲的字，她不相信父亲会卖掉它。取件员催她签交接单，拍卖二十分钟后就要开始；委托单上却签着母亲的名字。

改编选择：
保留字迹、倒计时和签名。把内心怀疑改成当着取件员的面检查座钟；下方袖口与座钟缺角是新增调度细节，不冒充原文事实。

剧本片段：
内景·维修铺·傍晚
沈宁翻过座钟，用左袖擦掉刻字上的灰。
沈宁：最后这个字，他每次都写反。
取件员：二十分钟。我还等你签字呢。
他把委托单推到工作台右侧。
沈宁伸手拿笔，看见委托人签名，停住。
沈宁：是我妈送来的？

四镜交接片段（不是完整单集，也不是可直接投产的完整分镜）：
01 座钟底部特写：灰尘遮着刻字，袖口擦过，字迹显露。职责是交付可识别的线索。
02 双人中景：沈宁抱着钟，取件员看时间。职责是让保留证据与交还座钟的压力同场成立。
03 委托单特写：纸从桌右推入，手指停在签名旁。职责是交付改变判断的新事实。
04 沈宁反应：笔尖悬在纸上，她抬眼看取件员。用有对象的问题结束，不只写“震惊表情”。

连续性备注：沈宁左袖有油渍；座钟右上角装饰缺失；委托单留在座钟右侧。此处尚未生成或绑定任何参考图片。

从四镜片段到三集候选地图
别把“EP001 擦出字迹 → EP002 取件员催促 → EP003 看见签名”当成已经成立的三集。这些先后动作可以服务于同一场戏，但尚未提供三次不同的选择及其后果。只凭上面的短源文，可以先完成一场戏；不必为了凑三集反复催签、插入新反派或截断一句话。

为演示另一种分集，本指南另写以下原创改编设定；它们不是那段源文已经交代的事实。真实改编中，应先让作者接受新增方向：
A. 母亲确实亲自签了委托单，打算把可能获得的拍卖款用于社区修理课的场地租金。尚未成交或到账，也没有证据表明这是父亲的遗愿。
B. 沈宁想保住与父亲有关的物件，但暂时拿不出替代租金。她需要决定怎样保留记忆，而不是再找一个“原来签错了”的巧合。
C. 取件员能在现场多等一分钟让她拍下刻字；这不等于他有权暂停拍卖。母亲可接电话，三集时间连续推进，二十分钟不会每集重置。

EP001｜认出的不是答案
入口：钟在维修铺，沈宁尚未签交接单；她认出钟底字迹，取件员正在催促。
目标与行动：先问清钟的来处再决定交还，她要求查看委托单。
转折与当集兑现：单上是母亲的名字。寻找委托人有了具体对象，但签名本身不能证明母亲的动机，甚至尚未由本人确认。
出口 → EP002：沈宁拿出手机拨给母亲。钟和未签的交接单仍在铺内；沈宁和观众都还不知道卖钟的理由。下一集从母亲接听开始，不重新表演一次“发现母亲名字”。

EP002｜留下也要有代价
入口：继承钟未交出、交接未签、电话待答的状态。
目标与行动：沈宁想让母亲收回委托。母亲在电话中确认亲自签署，并说出修理课租金的打算；沈宁提出留下钟，却答不出替代资金从哪里来。
转折与当集兑现：误送或签错的猜想被本人解释排除，冲突变成保留物件与支持课程之间的选择。观众现在知道母亲的计划，不等于知道父亲会赞成什么。
出口 → EP003：沈宁不再争论单据真伪。她结束通话，请取件员留一分钟拍清刻字，对方答应；钟仍未交出，最终选择仍由她作出。第三集不能又让她不知道租金计划，也不能把卖价写成已知金额。

EP003｜带走什么，留下什么
入口：钟仍在铺内，交接未签；拍照的一分钟已经开始，沈宁已知道母亲的计划。
选择与行动：她拍下刻字，把照片发给母亲，再签交接单、交出座钟。交接后，她告诉母亲钟已由取件员带走，并提出以后处置这些旧物先一起商量；母亲回复同意。
当集兑现：实物离开，刻字有了记录，母女作出一个具体的新约定。收束的是沈宁这次如何取舍，不是假装她不再难过。
结束状态：取件员带走钟，沈宁持有刻字照片，母亲知道她已交出钟。拍卖结果、实际收入与课程能否落实仍未发生；若继续写，它们属于后续任务，不凭空补一场绑架来强留悬念。

怎样决定保留三集还是合并？
删掉 EP002，沈宁就会从疑惑签名直接跳到交钟，缺少改变判断的理由；删掉 EP003，就只交代了计划，没有交出钟的选择后果。但这只说明这些状态台阶有用，不证明一定要分成三集。若目标时长、表演空间或材料支撑不足，可以把确认与决定合在同一集，不重复对白凑长度。本地图不是完整剧本，不宣称已达到 60–90 秒或已经拍成视频。

可接在前述请求后的分集范围：
先给一集与三集两种切法及其取舍，不写正文。逐集列入口事实、当集选择和结果、观众新知道什么、下一集必须继承什么。把源文事实与拟新增设定分开；缺失的动机不要替我拍板。等我接受分集和新增设定后，再只写 EP001，止步于文本。

en: A source/adaptation record and, when the task needs it, `项目开发/episode-map.jsonl`: the episode map separating established material, proposed changes and episode handoffs.

The requested episode uses `剧集/<EP>/剧本.md`; later stages can add `视觉设定.md`, `分镜.md`, `图片提示词.md` and `视频提示词.md` in that episode folder. These five document types are created as needed, not a requirement to generate every file in advance or proof that media exists.

An explicit next task: revise the pilot, write the next mapped episode or prepare a media-production preview. Text may inform a later workflow, but this does not establish automatic synchronization with Oh Story or the hosted ZenStory app.

For the next visual handoff, see [character consistency across shots](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/character-consistency): one original three-shot scene separates identity, costume, held props and real versus planned references.
zh: 原著与改编记录，以及任务需要时建立的 `项目开发/episode-map.jsonl`：分开记录已有材料、拟改内容和各集交接。
所请求单集的剧本位于 `剧集/<EP>/剧本.md`；进入后续阶段后，可在该集目录添加 `视觉设定.md`、`分镜.md`、`图片提示词.md`、`视频提示词.md`。五类文档按需创建，不要求提前建齐，也不证明媒体已经存在。
明确下一项创作任务：修改试写集、按地图写下一集，或准备媒体制作预览。文本可以给后续流程提供材料，但不表示与 Oh Story 或托管 ZenStory 应用自动同步。
进入视觉交接时，可读[角色跨镜一致性指南](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/character-consistency)：用原创三镜场景，区分人物身份、造型、持物状态，以及真实参考图与计划参考图。

en: Read the pilot against the source and the map: can the audience see the information needed to understand the turn, and does the next episode inherit the actual exit state? Treat proposed additions as author decisions.

A shot description or repeated continuity phrase is not evidence that generated faces, props, motion or voices match. Review real media separately if you later produce it; no quality, duration or publication result is established by this editorial example.
zh: 把试写集与原著、分集地图对照着读：观众是否看到了理解转折所需的信息，下一集是否继承了真实的出口状态？新增内容由作者决定。

title.en: Revise formulaic AI prose without changing your story
title.zh: AI 写的小说太套路？用具体改稿减少“AI 味”

answer.en: Treat “AI-sounding” prose as an editorial complaint to make specific: vague emotions, repeated sentence patterns, unearned commentary or dialogue that explains too much. Oh Story’s story-deslop combines pattern checks with bounded revision. The useful goal is a passage that serves its scene and keeps the author’s facts and voice—not an authorship verdict or a detector score. The original before/after example below shows one possible edit, not a recorded skill run.
answer.zh: 把“AI 味重”拆成能修改的问题：情绪太空泛、句式反复、议论拔高，或对白解释过多。Oh Story 的 story-deslop 把模式检查与有边界的修订结合起来。目标是让段落完成场景任务，同时保留作者设定和声音，不是判断作者身份或追求检测分数。下面的原创前后对照展示一种改法，不是一次技能运行记录。

en: Choose a passage, chapter or explicit set of files. For a short trial, paste the excerpt; for file-based work, keep a backup first. The documented file mode edits the specified manuscript files in place rather than returning a full replacement novel in chat.

Write down facts, viewpoint, information boundaries and any deliberate verbal habits that must survive. If you only want diagnosis, say “detection only; do not edit files”. For setup and installation-route syntax, use the [writer’s skill guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers).
zh: 选定一个片段、一章或明确的一组文件。短片段可直接粘贴；处理文件前先备份。文档中的文件模式会直接修改指定正文文件，不是在聊天里另给一本完整替换稿。
写清必须保留的事实、视角、信息边界，以及有意安排的口头习惯。只想找问题时，明确说“只检测，不修改文件”。安装与命令路径参见[作者 Skill 指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers)。

en: Name the reading problem

Instead of “make it human”, say what fails here: the paragraph names an emotion without showing its cause; several sentences repeat the same rhythm; or the narrator explains a choice that the action already makes clear. A metaphor, repeated phrase or polished sentence is not automatically a mistake. Keep it when it does useful work for this narrator, character or scene.
Set the preservation boundary

Separate the scene’s facts from wording you are willing to change. In the example, the last ferry, broken radio, ticket, hand movement and decision to stay are approved facts. The reason for staying must remain unrevealed. A new childhood memory or secret promise would be a story change, not merely a smoother sentence.
Ask for diagnosis before choosing edits

Use a /story-deslop request with the scope and “detection only” when you want to inspect findings first. The scanner identifies specified patterns and reports locations; a hit is not proof of bad prose or AI authorship. Ask why a flagged phrase is redundant in its actual scene, and leave purposeful expressions for contextual judgment. If the draft is truncated or shows blocking degeneration, return to the drafting/recovery workflow rather than trying to hide missing text with polish.
Revise the smallest useful unit

Prefer a word or sentence change over rebuilding an unaffected paragraph. Turn explanatory narration into clearer wording, an already-established action or dialogue where the scene supports it. The workflow limits deletion by severity and does not allow dropping whole paragraphs or losing plot functions. Shorter is not automatically better, and adding sensory decoration is not a substitute for a scene decision.
Compare meaning as well as wording

Read the original and revision side by side. Did a prop move, a character learn a secret, a promise disappear or the narrator suddenly gain access to another mind? Keep the revision only after resolving such changes. The example’s improvement is specific: dialogue carries the warning and the existing hand movement carries the hesitation, while a generic claim about destiny is removed.
Stop polishing and use the right next workflow

The documented pass stops after two rounds with no new change to the same paragraph, with at most three full-text rounds. Do not keep rewriting to chase a percentage. If a chapter needs changed events or a different information reveal, use the chapter-revision route and its tracking transaction instead. If you are importing an old book first, start with [import and continuation](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/import-and-continue).
zh: 先说清读起来哪里不对
不要只说“写得像人”，而要指出：这段只有情绪名称，没有造成情绪的原因；几句话节奏重复；或动作已经说明选择，旁白还在解释。比喻、重复、工整句子本身不是错误，只要它对当前叙述者、角色或场景有用，就可以保留。
划定不能改的故事边界
把场景事实与可改措辞分开。以下示例中，末班渡船、坏收音机、船票、手部动作和留下的决定都是已确认事实；留下的原因必须暂不揭露。新增童年回忆或秘密承诺，是改故事，不只是改顺一句话。
需要先看问题时，明确只检测
使用 /story-deslop 请求，并写明范围及“只检测”。扫描器定位指定模式；命中不等于文笔差，更不证明文本由 AI 创作。要求解释某处表达在当前场景里为什么冗余；有功能的写法留给语境判断，不机械删除。 如果草稿出现截断或阻断级退化，应回到写作、恢复流程处理，不用润色掩盖缺失内容。
修改能解决问题的最小单位
能换一个词、改一句，就不重建无关段落。场景允许时，可把解释腔换成更清楚的措辞、原本已有的动作或对白。流程按强度限制删除，不允许整段丢弃或删掉剧情功能。更短不自动等于更好，堆感官描写也不能代替场景中的选择。
前后对读，不只看句子顺不顺
检查改稿有没有移动道具、让角色提前知晓秘密、丢掉承诺，或突然读到了另一个人的内心。先解决这些变化，再接受修订。以下示例的修改理由很具体：用对白完成催促，用已有的手部动作承载犹豫，去掉没有增加信息的宏大议论。
到达目标就停，别反复磨成另一篇
文档规定同段两轮无新改动即停，全文最多三轮。不要为了一个百分比继续重写。如果需要改变事件或信息揭示，就进入章节大修及追踪事务，而不是借润色悄悄改剧情。旧书还没变成项目时，先看[导入续写指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/import-and-continue)。

example.en:
ORIGINAL EDITORIAL EXAMPLE — a possible edit written for this guide, not a recorded story-deslop run.
Approved facts: the last ferry sounds its horn; the radio remains dismantled; Chen Yu pushes a ticket to Lin Zhou and urges him to leave; the paper touches his hand; he withdraws it to hold the loose casing; Chen waits for his answer; he chooses to stay and tells her to go first. Do not reveal his reason.

Before:
The last ferry sounded its horn. Looking at the dismantled radio, Lin Zhou felt a surge of complicated emotions he could scarcely describe. Chen Yu pushed the ticket toward his hand and reminded him there was still time to leave. The paper touched him; he withdrew his hand and held the loose casing. He knew he stood at a crossroads in life. This was not merely a repair, but a defense of his deepest convictions. Finally, he chose to stay and told Chen Yu to go first.

One possible revision:
The last ferry sounded its horn. Chen Yu pushed the ticket toward Lin Zhou. “We can still make it.” He did not take it. His eyes stayed on the dismantled radio. The paper brushed his hand; he drew it back and held the loose casing instead. Chen Yu waited for an answer. Lin Zhou offered no reason for staying. “You go first.” The radio lay open on the table, the ticket still beside his hand.

What changed:
- The warning becomes direct dialogue; its meaning stays the same.
- The existing hand movement replaces a vague emotion label.
- The crossroads/convictions commentary is removed because it supplies no established reason in this scene.
- Names, objects, decision and withheld motive remain. This is one restrained voice choice, not a universal rule against expressive narration.

Suggested request for YOUR excerpt, after the skill is installed:
/story-deslop
Detection only. Identify specific wording problems in the passage below; do not edit any file.
Preserve my fact list, viewpoint and intentional dialogue habits. Explain each suggested change in context.
[Paste your approved facts and passage.]

After reviewing the findings, request a bounded revision and a before/after explanation. For file mode, inspect the saved file and backup rather than expecting the whole chapter in chat.
example.zh:
原创改稿示例——为本指南写的一种方案，不是 story-deslop 运行记录。
已确认事实：末班渡船鸣笛；收音机仍拆着；陈雨推来船票并催林舟离开；纸边碰到他的手；他收手按住松开的机壳；陈雨等他答复；他决定留下，让陈雨先走。暂不揭露留下的原因。

改前：
末班渡船的汽笛响了，林舟看着桌上拆开的收音机，内心涌起一股难以言喻的复杂情绪。陈雨把船票推到他手边，提醒他现在走还来得及。纸边碰到他的手，他收回手，按住松开的机壳。他知道，自己正站在人生的十字路口；这不仅仅是一次维修，更是对内心信念的坚守。最终，他决定留下，让陈雨先走。

一种改法：
末班渡船的汽笛响了。陈雨把船票推到林舟手边：“现在走，还来得及。”林舟没有拿票，仍看着拆开的收音机。纸边碰到他的手，他把手收回去，按住松开的机壳。陈雨还在等他的答复。林舟没有解释为什么要留下，只说：“你先走。”收音机仍拆在桌上，船票还搁在他的手边。

为什么这样改：
- 用直接对白完成催促，不改变这句话传达的意思。
- 用原本就有的手部动作承载犹豫，替换空泛情绪标签。
- “人生十字路口”“信念坚守”没有交付已成立的动机，在这里删掉。
- 人名、物件、选择和未揭露的原因保留。这只是克制叙述的一种选择，不是禁止抒情旁白的通用规则。

技能安装后，可这样请求处理自己的片段：
/story-deslop
只检测下面这段的具体措辞问题，不修改任何文件。
保留我的事实卡、视角和有意安排的口头习惯，结合场景说明每项建议。
[粘贴你已确认的事实和正文。]

审阅建议后，再请求有范围的修订及前后说明。文件模式应检查已保存正文和备份，不必期待聊天里返回整章。

en: Detection-only work should give located findings and reasons without changing the manuscript. A zero-pattern result is not a certificate of authorship or literary quality.

A requested revision in file mode is saved to the specified text files. The documented report includes change statistics and before/after information; it returns only a short representative excerpt rather than the complete file text.

For a change to events, timeline or reader knowledge, use the chapter-revision transaction to update tracking authority and derived views. Do not manually patch separate tracking files to make them appear consistent.

If the edit sounds smoother but no longer sounds like you, use [preserve your author voice](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/preserve-author-voice) to separate this book’s style, a one-off request and a lasting preference without copying the sample’s story facts.
zh: 只检测时，应获得问题位置与理由，正文不应被修改。“没有命中模式”不是作者身份或文学质量证明。
文件模式中，已请求的修订写回指定正文文件。文档要求报告修改统计与前后信息；聊天只回传简短代表片段，不回传文件全文。
改动涉及事件、时间线或读者认知时，通过章节修订事务更新追踪权威与派生视图，不要分别手补追踪文件来凑一致。
改完更顺，却不像自己了？看[保留作者文风](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/preserve-author-voice)，分清本书笔调、一次性要求与长期偏好，不把样本的故事事实一并搬来。

en: Ask whether the scene is clearer while the author’s facts, voice and pacing still hold. A recurring phrase may be intentional; pattern counts do not overrule that judgment.
External AI detectors cannot be promised a score by this workflow. This guide concerns prose revision, not hiding provenance or establishing a “human-written” percentage.
zh: 判断场景是否更清楚，同时作者的事实、声音和节奏是否还在。重复表达可能有意为之，模式数量不能替代这种判断。
此流程不承诺外部 AI 检测分数。本指南谈正文修订，不以隐藏来源或建立“真人写作比例”为目标。

title.en: Turn a local video into a source-grounded Chinese narration recap
title.zh: 怎样把本地视频做成有画面与原声依据的中文解说

answer.en: Video Recap Skills separates a Chinese-narration recap into understanding, editorial planning, narration, voiceover and assembly. Starting from an authorized local video, it builds a scene/speech/frame evidence index, chooses a viewer promise and POV, and writes only claims that evidence or supplied context supports. It can deliver a rendered MP4 or an editable draft—not merely a summary over footage.
answer.zh: Video Recap Skills 把中文视频解说拆成理解、编导、写稿、配音与合成。先从你有权使用的本地视频提取场景、对白和画面证据，再确定一条观众承诺与主视角，只写素材或已提供背景能够支持的内容。最终可交付解说 MP4，也可另导出可编辑草稿，而不是给原片随意铺一层摘要。

en: Install Video Recap Skills in a supported agent host using the current route on the [project page](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap), then open the authorized video’s workspace. In manual commands, /ABS/video-recap-skills means the installed checkout’s absolute path—not a system path.

A local .mp4, .mov, .mkv or .webm that you own or may process, plus Python 3.10+, ffmpeg on PATH and space for frames, WAV files and renders. Burned subtitles require ffmpeg’s libass/subtitles filter.

A Xiaomi MiMo API key for remote ASR, VLM and default TTS. Fish Audio can replace TTS only and needs another key; ASR/VLM still use MiMo. This is not fully offline. Check provider privacy, region and billing terms before sending authorized material.
zh: 先在受支持的 Agent 宿主中安装并配置 Video Recap Skills；按[项目页](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap)选择当前宿主的安装方式，再用该宿主打开获准视频所在工作区。下文手工命令中的 /ABS/video-recap-skills，指已安装 skill 仓库的绝对路径，不是系统自带目录。
一个你拥有或获准处理的本地 .mp4、.mov、.mkv 或 .webm，以及 Python 3.10+、PATH 中的 ffmpeg 和足够的中间文件空间。烧录字幕需要 ffmpeg 的 libass/subtitles filter。
远程 ASR、VLM 与默认 TTS 需要 Xiaomi MiMo API key。Fish Audio 只能替换 TTS，并需要独立 key；ASR/VLM 仍用 MiMo。这不是全离线流程，发送获准素材前应查看服务商当前的隐私、地区与计费条款。

en: Choose the edit shape

Primary route: invoke the installed video-recap skill in its configured host (for hosts exposing that slash name, /video-recap) with a natural-language brief. Use full to retain the source timeline; use cut for a shorter story rendered before narration. State audience, duration, context, subtitles and material that must survive.
Build an evidence index

Understanding detects scenes, extracts frames, transcribes speech, finds quiet windows and writes timeline_fusion.json plus agent_narration_brief.md. It observes rather than invents: facts and inference remain separate. Script-first entry: python3 /ABS/video-recap-skills/skills/video-understanding/scripts/understand.py /ABS/input.mp4 --work-dir /ABS/work.
Choose an angle before writing

Read the brief, contact sheet, frame facts and ASR. Decide the viewer promise, POV, dramatic question, emotional endpoint and delayed information. For a new recap, compare viable story shapes; for a directed request, honor that direction. Record the spine and change-based beats in recap_story_plan.json.
Assign picture, original sound and narration

In visual_audio_board.json, give every beat a picture task, preferred reaction, in/out reason, original-audio anchor and audio owner. Strong dialogue, action sound or silence may carry a beat alone. In cut mode, create clip_plan.json first; after edited_source.mp4 exists, recheck its storyboard and write on output time.
Write source-grounded Chinese narration

A narration.json block needs a job: context, causal link, foreshadowing, interpretation or transition. Do not restate visible action. Names, motives, relationships and outcomes must trace to visual evidence, ASR, reliable research or user context; never disguise background knowledge as an on-screen fact. Write complete spoken thoughts and preserve dialogue boundaries.
Review, voice and assemble

Ask whether every beat changes knowledge, power, goal, relationship, emotion or risk, and whether any claim lacks support. To review before TTS, take the stage route: after video-understanding, invoke video-script, inspect its plans/narration, then run python3 /ABS/video-recap-skills/skills/video-script/scripts/validate.py --work-dir /ABS/work --mode full. Only then run voiceover.py and assemble.py from their skill directories. Cut validation uses the orchestrator’s output-timeline mode.
Resume from real artifacts

The installed skill normally handles internal handoffs. For script-level cut control, start with python3 /ABS/video-recap-skills/skills/video-recap/scripts/recap.py /ABS/input.mp4 --work-dir /ABS/work --edit-mode cut --target-duration 6m. It exits after analysis for an agent/script handoff, not default human approval. After the required clip plan or narration exists, rerun that exact command; the manifest rejects mismatched source/settings. If you chose stage review, wait before rerunning. After timeline.json exists, use the [draft export guide](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/capcut-draft).
zh: 先选成片形态
主入口是在已配置宿主中调用安装好的 video-recap skill（宿主若暴露该 slash 名，则用 /video-recap），再提交自然语言简报。原片时间线保持完整、只在合适位置加旁白用 full；长素材要收成短故事用 cut，它先剪片，再按剪后时间轴写稿。说明受众、时长、背景、字幕和必须保留的素材。
建立视听证据索引

理解阶段检测场景、抽取代表帧、转写对白、寻找静音窗，并融合为 timeline_fusion.json 与 agent_narration_brief.md。它负责观察，不负责编故事：事实与推断分开，证据不足就保留不确定。脚本优先入口：python3 /ABS/video-recap-skills/skills/video-understanding/scripts/understand.py /ABS/input.mp4 --work-dir /ABS/work。
先定角度，再写开场
阅读 brief、contact sheet、frame facts 与 ASR，确定观众承诺、POV、戏剧问题、情绪终点和暂缓揭示的信息。首次创作比较可成立的故事结构；用户已给方向时忠实落实。把选定主线和“发生了什么变化”的 beats 写进 recap_story_plan.json。
分配画面、原声与旁白
在 visual_audio_board.json 中为每个 beat 记录画面任务、关键反应或表演、入出点理由、原声锚点和 audio_owner。强对白、动作声或沉默可以独占一拍，不必强铺旁白。cut 模式先写 clip_plan.json；edited_source.mp4 生成后，再看剪后故事板并按输出时间写稿。
写有证据的中文解说
只有一段旁白承担 context、causal_link、foreshadow、interpretation 或 transition 时才写。画面已经说清楚的事不要复述。人物名、动机、关系和结果必须来自画面、ASR、可靠背景或用户上下文，不能把背景资料伪装成当前镜头事实。每段写成可连续朗读的完整意思，并保住原声句界。
短审文案，再配音合成

复核每个 beat 是否改变认知、权力、目标、关系、情绪或风险，只听声音能否懂主线，以及有没有无依据断言。想在 TTS 前人工审阅，就走阶段入口：video-understanding 后调用 video-script，检查计划与旁白，再执行 python3 /ABS/video-recap-skills/skills/video-script/scripts/validate.py --work-dir /ABS/work --mode full；通过后才运行各 skill 目录中的 voiceover.py 与 assemble.py。cut 的输出时间轴校验由编排器选择对应模式。
从真实产物继续

通常由已安装 skill 处理内部交接。若要用脚本明确控制 cut 流程，先执行 python3 /ABS/video-recap-skills/skills/video-recap/scripts/recap.py /ABS/input.mp4 --work-dir /ABS/work --edit-mode cut --target-duration 6m。它在分析后退出，把产物交给 Agent/写稿阶段；这不表示默认流程会请求人工批准。所需 clip plan 或 narration 写好后原样重跑该命令，manifest 会拒绝不匹配的源视频或设置。若选择了阶段审阅，就先保持停止。已有 timeline.json 后再看[草稿导出指南](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/capcut-draft)。

example.en:
For a host exposing this slash name (otherwise select video-recap), this is an original suggested brief—not recorded output, a benchmark or an executed provider run. Its path and timestamps are illustrative placeholders:

/video-recap
Create a six-minute Chinese recap from /ABS/interview.mov in cut mode. I may use it. Show how the guest’s launch claim changes after the failed demonstration. Follow the guest’s POV until failure, then the engineer’s reaction. Preserve the full 18:40–19:05 exchange without narration. Use visible action, transcribed speech and my context; mark uncertain identities. Build the evidence and story/audio plan before concise spoken Chinese. Burn subtitles and retain timeline.json for draft export.
example.zh:
若宿主把已安装 skill 暴露为这个 slash 名（否则在宿主中选择或点名 video-recap），下面是原创建议简报，不是已记录输出、基准结果或执行过的服务商调用。路径与时间戳只是示意占位，不是来自真实文件的证据：

/video-recap
把 /ABS/interview.mov 用 cut 模式做成约六分钟中文解说。我已获准使用录像。让观众看清嘉宾自信的发布承诺怎样在演示失败后变化。失败前跟随嘉宾视角，之后转向工程师反应。完整保留 18:40–19:05 原声，不铺旁白。只使用可见动作、转写对白和我的背景；身份不确定就标明。先建立证据索引与故事/声音方案，再写简洁口语。成片烧录字幕，并保留 timeline.json 以便之后导出草稿。

en: Understanding: scenes.json, asr_result.json, vlm_analysis.json, silence_periods.json, timeline_fusion.json and agent_narration_brief.md.
Editorial: recap_story_plan.json, visual_audio_board.json, optional style_card.json, narration.json and, for cut, clip_plan.json plus edited_source.mp4.
Delivery: TTS WAV/metadata, recap_<name>.mp4, subtitles.srt/.ass and timeline.json; editable-draft export is separate.

For a concrete edit decision, see [original sound versus narration](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/original-audio-and-narration): an original five-beat radio scene shows when dialogue, action sound or a pause should lead, and why audio-owner labels alone do not control the mix.
zh: 理解产物：scenes.json、asr_result.json、vlm_analysis.json、silence_periods.json、timeline_fusion.json 与 agent_narration_brief.md。
编导交接：recap_story_plan.json、visual_audio_board.json、可选 style_card.json、narration.json；cut 模式另有 clip_plan.json 与 edited_source.mp4。
交付产物：TTS WAV 分段与元数据、recap_<name>.mp4、subtitles.srt/.ass 和 timeline.json；可编辑草稿是独立的可选导出。
需要具体剪辑判断时，可读[原声与旁白怎样分工](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/original-audio-and-narration)：原创收音机五拍示例说明何时让对白、动作声或停顿主导，以及为什么只写声音职责标签不能直接控制混音。

en: Before TTS, spot-check names, actions, quoted speech and causal claims against frames/ASR; read narration aloud for complete thoughts and usable pauses.
Before delivery, watch the actual final file once, listen once without looking, and inspect joins around preserved dialogue. Reports locate candidates; they do not replace playback.
zh: 配音前抽查人名、动作、引用对白和因果是否能对回画面与 ASR，并朗读一遍旁白，确认意思完整、停顿可说。
交付前以正常速度完整看一次实际成片，再只听声音一次，并检查保留原声前后的接点。自动报告只能定位候选问题，不能替代播放。
