title.en: Turn a novel scene into meaningful choices and different endings
title.zh: 小说改互动文游：怎样让选择真正改变剧情和结局

answer.en: Start with what the player can change, not a button for every paragraph. Preserve the source facts, give each choice a cost and a visible consequence, and carry its state into later scenes. This guide turns one original ferry scene into two decision points and three outcomes before handing the design to Novel to Game. These are authored design notes, not a generated game or proof that a build works.
answer.zh: 先确定玩家能改变什么，不要给每段小说机械加上按钮。守住原文事实，让每次选择都有代价与可见后果，并把结果带到后续场景。本指南用一个原创渡口场景，演示两个选择点、三个结果怎样交给 Novel to Game 继续设计；示例是作者设计稿，不是已生成或已运行的游戏。

en: Use a scene you wrote or are authorized to adapt. Separate source facts, author-approved additions and unresolved questions; a character must not act on information they have not learned.
Choose a small narrative-led experience: one player role, a concrete objective, a few locations and an ending condition. More branches are not automatically more agency.

For host setup and the complete pipeline, use the [Novel-to-game quick start](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/quick-start). This page focuses on adaptation decisions, not another installation walkthrough.
zh: 使用你创作或获准改编的场景。区分原文事实、作者批准的新增设定与待定问题；角色不能使用尚未获知的信息。
先限定一个叙事主导的小体验：一个玩家身份、明确目标、少量地点与结束条件。分支数量多不等于玩家更有决定权。
宿主配置与完整流程见[小说改游戏入门](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/quick-start)。这一页只解决改编设计问题，不重复安装教程。

en: Find the decision hidden in the prose

Write the player’s goal, what blocks it, and what they can actually do. In the ferry example the goal is to leave tonight; the obstacle is an unreadable ticket stamp. Asking someone, fetching a document and accepting a recorded exception are actions; “feel anxious” alone is not.
Protect the source before adding routes

Put cited facts and uncertainties in `analysis/SOURCE_BIBLE.md`. Mark the ferry’s witness-and-register exception as an author-approved rule rather than pretending it was found in the novel. Record narrative-led scope and limits in `PRODUCT_BRIEF.md`; let `game-concept` resolve the concept before expanding it.
Give each option a trade-off the player can understand

Fetching an official duplicate is dependable but misses tonight’s boat. Finding a witness preserves the chance of boarding but requires a named exception. Explain these stakes before the commitment. Avoid differently worded buttons that immediately produce the same information and state.
Describe conditions and effects in plain language

For every choice record: what the player knows, when the option is allowed, what changes, and what the player sees. `proof`, `on_time` and `exception_consent` below are design labels, not built-in Novel to Game APIs. A generic affinity meter is unnecessary unless relationships actually change decisions.
Rejoin locations, not erased histories

Both routes can return to the same dock and reuse its art. Keep the evidence and missed-departure state: the duplicate route offers a morning reservation; the witness route offers a recorded exception or staying behind. A later scene must read these differences instead of silently resetting them.
Hand over the causal design before expanding production

Ask `game-world-design` to put the state transitions, ending conditions, narrative beats and smallest playable slice in `design/GAME_DESIGN.md`. Request a design-only handoff explicitly; the main `novel-to-game quick` mode otherwise continues the pipeline. Plain-language input, if used, should map to permitted actions rather than letting a persuasive sentence invent evidence or grant a ticket.
zh: 从正文里找出真正的决定
写出玩家目标、阻碍，以及玩家实际能做的动作。渡口示例的目标是今晚离开，阻碍是船票印章模糊。询问证人、补办凭证、接受登记例外是动作；“感到焦虑”本身不是。
先保护原文，再增加分支
将有引用的事实与疑点写入 `analysis/SOURCE_BIBLE.md`。渡口的“证人加登记”例外要标成作者批准的新增规则，不能假装小说已经写过。在 `PRODUCT_BRIEF.md` 限定叙事主导的范围和边界，先由 `game-concept` 明确概念，再扩展分支。
让每个选项都有玩家看得懂的取舍
回售票处补办正式凭证稳妥，却会错过今晚的船；寻找证人保留登船机会，但要实名登记为例外。提交选择前说明代价，不要只换按钮措辞，转头又给出完全相同的信息和状态。
用普通话说明条件和后果
逐项写清：玩家已经知道什么、何时能选、选后改变什么、画面或人物如何反馈。下面的 `proof`、`on_time`、`exception_consent` 只是设计记号，不是 Novel to Game 内置 API。关系不影响选择时，不必硬加好感度条。
可以回到同一地点，不能抹掉经历
两条路线都能回到渡口并复用背景，但保留凭证类型与是否错过船的状态：补票路线只能预约明早；证人路线可接受实名例外或留在岸上。后续场景必须读取这些差异，而不是悄悄重置。
先交清因果设计，再扩展制作
要求 `game-world-design` 在 `design/GAME_DESIGN.md` 写清状态变化、结局条件、叙事节拍和最小可玩切片。只要设计交接时须明确要求；总入口 `novel-to-game quick` 默认会继续整个流程。若使用自然语言输入，也应映射到允许的动作，不能靠一句“说服他”凭空造出证据或船票。

example.en:
Original editorial example — The Last Ferry (not tool output)

Prose seed:
The last ferry sounded its warning. Rain had blurred the stamp on Qiao Ning’s
ticket. The keeper laid it beside the register instead of tearing it in half.
“The ticket office can issue a duplicate,” he said. “But not before we leave.”

Approved facts: Qiao Ning bought a ticket; its stamp is now unreadable.
She wants to cross tonight. The keeper cannot accept the blurred stamp alone.
Approved adaptation addition: a purchase witness plus Qiao Ning’s consent to
enter her name in the exception register permits boarding before departure.
The witness route is feasible tonight; a trip to the office misses the ferry.
No invented bribe, forged ticket, secret relative or magical shortcut.

Design notes, not executable syntax:
Initial state: proof=none; on_time=true; exception_consent=false; ending=none.

Decision 1 — choose how to establish the purchase:
A. Fetch an official duplicate; the boat will leave before you return.
   Effect: proof=duplicate; on_time=false.
   Visible feedback: the dock is empty; the keeper offers the morning crossing.
   Outcome A: a confirmed morning place, not a successful departure tonight.
B. Ask the passenger who witnessed your purchase to speak to the keeper.
   Effect: proof=witness; on_time=true. A witness statement enters the register.
   Visible feedback: the keeper explains the named-exception requirement.
   Continue to Decision 2.

Decision 2 — available only with a witness and before departure:
A. Consent to the named exception.
   Effect: exception_consent=true; ending=departed_with_record.
   Outcome B: board tonight; the next scene retains the exception record.
B. Decline the registration.
   Effect: exception_consent=false; ending=stayed_ashore.
   Outcome C: remain ashore; do not silently board in the following scene.

Terminal rule: the duplicate route sets ending=morning_place.
No option from the witness branch is available after that ending.
Restart clears proof, timing, consent and ending to their initial values.

Design-only request for a configured agent with the skills installed:
Use this original scene to prepare a narrative-led adaptation design.
Keep the source facts and label the exception rule as my approved addition.
Use novel-game-analyze, game-concept and game-world-design as appropriate.
Write the brief, source bible, chosen concept and GAME_DESIGN handoff.
Keep two decision points and these three outcomes; list each condition, effect
and player-visible consequence. Do not build or generate paid assets yet.
List unresolved decisions instead of expanding the story on my behalf.
example.zh:
原创编辑示例——《末班渡船》（不是工具运行结果）

正文种子：
末班渡船响过催行的汽笛。乔宁船票上的印章被雨水洇开了。
守船人把票压在登记簿旁，没有撕掉。
“售票处能补凭证，”他说，“但等你回来，这班船就走了。”

批准的事实：乔宁确实买过票，但印章已模糊。她希望今晚渡河。
守船人不能仅凭模糊印章放行。
批准的改编新增规则：购票证人作证，且乔宁同意在例外登记簿实名登记，
便可在开船前登船。找证人来得及；回售票处则一定错过本班。
不新增贿赂、假票、隐藏亲属或超自然捷径。

以下是设计记号，不是可执行语法：
初始：proof=none；on_time=true；exception_consent=false；ending=none。

选择点1——怎样证明自己买过票：
A. 回售票处补正式凭证；提前告知返回时船已开走。
   后果：proof=duplicate；on_time=false。
   可见反馈：回到空渡口，守船人提供明早的船位。
   结果A：确认明早可走，不算今晚成功渡河。
B. 请见过你购票的乘客向守船人作证。
   后果：proof=witness；on_time=true；证词记入登记簿。
   可见反馈：守船人说明必须实名登记为例外，进入选择点2。

选择点2——仅在有证人且尚未开船时可选：
A. 同意实名登记。
   后果：exception_consent=true；ending=departed_with_record。
   结果B：今晚登船；下一场仍保留这笔例外记录。
B. 不接受登记。
   后果：exception_consent=false；ending=stayed_ashore。
   结果C：留在岸上；下一场不能又默认角色已经登船。

结束规则：补凭证路线设置 ending=morning_place。
到达该结果后，不再允许使用证人路线的选项。
重新开始时，凭证、时间、同意状态和结局都恢复初始值。

交给已配置且安装了相关技能的 Agent 的“只做设计”请求：
用上述原创场景准备一个叙事主导的互动改编设计。
保留原文事实，把实名例外规则标成我批准的新增设定。
按需要使用 novel-game-analyze、game-concept、game-world-design。
交付产品简报、原著圣经、选定概念及 GAME_DESIGN 设计交接。
先只保留两个选择点与这三个结果，逐项写明条件、变化和玩家可见后果。
暂不构建，不生成付费素材；列出待决项，不擅自替我扩写故事。

en: `PRODUCT_BRIEF.md`: player role, scope, narrative-led intent, language and eventual target runtime; a design-only stopping point is not a playable-delivery claim.
`analysis/SOURCE_BIBLE.md` and `concepts/CONCEPT.md`: cited source facts, approved adaptation departures and the chosen experience.

`design/GAME_DESIGN.md`: a small route map, readable conditions/effects, information disclosure, ending rules and the smallest playable slice. Put the example’s notes inside this handoff; no new mandatory filename or engine is implied.

When you later request a build, use the [complete quick start](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/quick-start). Separately trace each intended ending; one completed playthrough does not establish every route.
zh: `PRODUCT_BRIEF.md`：玩家身份、范围、叙事主导意图、语言与后续目标运行环境；停在设计交接不等于已交付可玩游戏。
`analysis/SOURCE_BIBLE.md` 与 `concepts/CONCEPT.md`：带出处的原文事实、批准的改编偏离，以及选定体验。
`design/GAME_DESIGN.md`：小范围路线图、清晰的条件/后果、信息披露、结局规则和最小可玩切片。示例设计说明放进该交接即可，不增加必需文件名，也不绑定引擎。
后续需要构建时，回到[完整入门流程](https://zenstory.ai/novel-to-game/quick-start)。每个计划中的结局须分别走通；一次完整试玩不代表所有路线已经覆盖。

en: At the design desk, trace each route and ask: what can change because of this choice, what is its cost, and where does the player see the consequence? If only the wording changes, either label it expressive flavor or give it a real downstream role.

Check impossible combinations: boarding after the ferry has left, using a witness before finding one, or retaining old consent after restart. These are review questions for your implementation, not claims that this page ran it.

Novel to Game is a skills workflow, not a bundled branching engine or a guarantee of coherent, entertaining endings. Runtime state commits must follow replayable rules; a language model’s narration is not itself proof of a state change.
zh: 在设计稿里逐条走路线：这个选择究竟改变什么、付出什么、玩家在哪里看见后果？如果只改措辞，要么明确它只是表达差异，要么给它真实的后续作用。
检查不可能的组合：船开后仍登船、尚未找到证人就用证词、重开后残留旧的同意状态。这些是留给实现的检查问题，不表示本页已经运行过游戏。
Novel to Game 是技能工作流，不是内置分支引擎，也不保证结局自然或好玩。运行时状态须由可重放规则提交；模型叙述“你已上船”本身不等于状态真的改变。

title.en: Character consistency in AI short drama: identity, costume and shot continuity
title.zh: AI 短剧怎样保持角色跨镜一致：人物、造型与镜头状态

answer.en: Separate the person’s persistent identity from the current costume and each shot’s action. Keep only genuinely unchanged visual facts in a continuity lock; track hands, props and gaze as shot state. An original three-shot archive scene below shows how to connect these decisions. A character sheet or an image-prompt ID is not a generated reference image, and written constraints do not guarantee a model’s results. For the wider adaptation workflow, start with the [novel-to-short-drama guide](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/novel-to-short-drama).
answer.zh: 先把不随换装改变的人物身份、当前造型与每镜动作分开。只把真正跨镜不变的外观写入连续性锁，手持物、视线和姿势则按镜头记录。下面用原创的档案馆三镜示例，说明怎样把这些决定连起来。有角色设定或图片提示词编号，不等于已有真实参考图；文字约束也不保证模型最终效果。完整改编流程可从[小说改短剧指南](https://zenstory.ai/drama-skills/novel-to-short-drama)开始。

en: An accepted scene or episode script. It should establish who appears, which visible state matters and what changes during each shot; resolve story meaning in writing rather than hiding it inside an appearance prompt.
Creator-approved identity facts and scene styling. Do not invent age, ethnicity, facial traits, branded clothing or other details merely to fill a template. Mark unresolved choices instead.

If you plan to use the documented skills, a configured supported agent host and project folder. This guide does not execute image or video generation and its example contains no generated reference asset.
zh: 准备已接受的场次或单集剧本，写清谁出现、哪些可见状态重要、每镜发生什么变化。知识、目标和关系属于编剧，不要把故事语义藏进外观提示词。
准备创作者确认过的身份事实与本场造型。不要为了填模板擅自补年龄、族裔、五官、品牌服装等细节；未决定的内容继续标为待定。
如要使用文档中的技能，还需已配置的受支持 Agent 宿主和项目目录。本指南不执行图片或视频生成，示例也没有生成参考素材。

en: Write Character as the persistent identity

Use observable, comparable anchors that survive a costume change and work beyond a front-facing close-up. In the example, Lin Lan has a V-shaped nape hairline and a right shoulder that sits slightly lower than the left. These belong to Character; the rain jacket, hand-held key, gaze and pose do not. Ask `short-drama-assets` to record the accepted facts in `剧集/<EP>/视觉设定.md`.
Add one compatible Look for this scene

Reference the Character, then record only clothing, hair arrangement, makeup, injury or weathering that can coexist now. Lin Lan’s scene Look is a low-tied hairstyle and a dark-teal matte hooded work jacket with two rows of silver snaps on the left cuff. Keep the brass key as a Prop and its current holder as shot state; neither is part of the Look.
Lock only the invariant visible surface

A LOCK is justified when the fact appears across at least two shots, viewers could notice a mismatch and the story does not change it. Use the minimal phrase “dark-teal matte hooded work jacket, hood down, two rows of silver snaps on the left cuff” across the affected `IMG-*` body, frozen keyframe and `MOTION-*` body. Do not lock the key’s position, hand pose or gaze because those change.
Chain three shots with explicit states

For every shot write `start → one primary action → end`, including each hand, held prop and gaze. The next shot must start from the previous shot’s actual end unless the screenplay establishes a cut or state change. A frozen keyframe normally describes the start only; it must not show an action or prop state that first appears at the end.
Keep prompt IDs separate from media evidence

Use `short-drama-image-prompts` only to author entries such as `IMG-CHAR-LINLAN` and `IMG-LOOK-LINLAN-RAIN`; those IDs do not prove files exist. In `short-drama-storyboard`, bind an inspected project image as `REF-*`. If the creator will supply it later, keep a `PLAN-*` slot with order, intended file, purpose, control scope and exclusions. Missing files must not be silently downgraded to text-to-video.
Stop at a production-honest handoff

A `PLAN-*` shot may describe the intended image-to-video path, but it cannot enter `short-drama-produce` until the real file is present and the slot becomes `REF-*`. For a continuing shot chain, later segments also need the preceding actual video and actual tail frame; planned frames or prose cannot substitute. Text constraints improve the handoff, but do not guarantee a model will preserve face, clothing, space, props or motion.
zh: 先写长期不变的 Character 身份
选换装后仍成立、可观察、可比较，并能在侧面或背面识别的锚点。示例中的林岚有 V 形后颈发际，右肩略低于左肩；这些属于 Character。雨衣、手里的钥匙、视线和姿势都不属于身份。可用 `short-drama-assets` 把已确认事实写入 `剧集/<EP>/视觉设定.md`。
再写本场相容的 Look
先引用 Character，只补本场能同时存在的服装、发型、妆伤与天气化。林岚本场是低束发，穿墨绿色哑光连帽工作夹克，左袖有双排银色按扣。黄铜钥匙仍是 Prop，由谁拿着属于镜头状态，不能吞进 Look。
只锁真正不变的可见表面
同一事实跨至少两镜可见、观众能发现不一致、剧情又不会改变它，才写 LOCK。示例锁面是“墨绿色哑光连帽工作夹克，帽子放下，左袖双排银色按扣”，在受影响的 `IMG-*` 正文、冻结关键帧和 `MOTION-*` 正文中原样携带。钥匙位置、手势和视线会变化，不上锁。
用状态链写三镜
每镜都按“起点 → 唯一主要动作 → 终点”记录双手、持物与视线；除非剧本明确跳时空，下一镜起点应继承上一镜真实终点。冻结关键帧默认只写起点，不能提前出现终点才成立的动作或道具状态。
把提示词编号与真实素材分开
`short-drama-image-prompts` 可写 `IMG-CHAR-LINLAN`、`IMG-LOOK-LINLAN-RAIN`，但编号不证明图片存在。到 `short-drama-storyboard`，检查过且项目内可读的图片才写 `REF-*`；创作者计划稍后提供时保留 `PLAN-*`，注明顺序、拟用文件、用途、控制范围与不得控制范围。缺图不能静默降级为文生视频。
以诚实的投产边界收尾
`PLAN-*` 可以记录预期的图生视频路径，但真实文件入项并改为 `REF-*` 前，不能交给 `short-drama-produce`。连续时空的后续段还需要上一段实际视频和实际尾帧；文字或计划帧不能冒充。文本约束能改善交接，却不保证模型最终稳定人脸、服装、空间、道具或动作。

example.en:
ORIGINAL EDITORIAL EXAMPLE — written for this guide, not skill output, generated media or a production test.
Scene: At a rain-soaked archive loading bay, Lin Lan must open locker 17 while keeping a red evidence folder dry. The steel bench stands directly beside locker 17, so the three shots require no off-shot repositioning. Her jacket hood stays down, leaving the nape anchor visible.

Character — Lin Lan: V-shaped nape hairline; right shoulder slightly lower than left.
Look — LOOK-LINLAN-RAIN: references Lin Lan; low-tied hair; dark-teal matte hooded work jacket; hood down; two rows of silver snaps on the left cuff.
LOCK — LOCK-LINLAN-JACKET: “dark-teal matte hooded work jacket, hood down, two rows of silver snaps on the left cuff”; active in SHOT-01 through SHOT-03.
Prop — brass locker key and red evidence folder remain separate assets. Throughout these three shots, the left arm pins the folder and the left hand supports its lower edge; only the right hand handles the key.

SHOT-01 — Start: folder tucked under left arm, key on the steel bench, right hand empty, gaze on the key. Action: Lin Lan picks up the key with her right hand. End: folder under left arm, key in right hand, gaze shifts to locker 17.
SHOT-02 — Start: inherit the preceding end. Action: she inserts the key into locker 17. End: folder under left arm, key remains in the lock, right hand stays on it, gaze on the keyhole.
SHOT-03 — Start: inherit the preceding end. Action: she turns the key once. End: folder still under left arm, key turned in the lock, right hand on the key, gaze moves to the door seam.

Prompt/reference record: `IMG-CHAR-LINLAN` and `IMG-LOOK-LINLAN-RAIN` name prompt entries only. `PLAN-LINLAN-RAIN-01` points to the explicitly non-existent placeholder `剧集/EP001/待提供/林岚雨夜造型.png` below, first in reference order, for identity and compatible Look only; it must not control hand pose, key position, gaze or camera. No real file has been provided, inspected or bound, so all three shots remain PLAN and are not production-ready. No image, video, face-consistency or motion result is claimed.

Copyable text-only handoff request:
For EP001, use `short-drama-assets`, `short-drama-image-prompts` and `short-drama-storyboard` to organize Lin Lan and these three shots. Keep Character, Look, LOCK and shot state separate. Stop at text files; do not generate images, video, voices or music. `剧集/EP001/待提供/林岚雨夜造型.png` is a placeholder path, not an existing file. Keep it as PLAN and do not prepare a production submission.
example.zh:
原创编辑示例——为本指南编写，不是技能执行输出、生成媒体或投产测试。
场景：雨夜的档案馆装卸区，林岚要打开 17 号柜，同时护住一份红色证物夹。钢台紧挨 17 号柜，三镜之间无需补走位；夹克帽子保持放下，让后颈锚点可见。

Character｜林岚：V 形后颈发际；右肩略低于左肩。
Look｜LOOK-LINLAN-RAIN：引用林岚；低束发；墨绿色哑光连帽工作夹克；帽子放下；左袖双排银色按扣。
LOCK｜LOCK-LINLAN-JACKET：“墨绿色哑光连帽工作夹克，帽子放下，左袖双排银色按扣”；SHOT-01 至 SHOT-03 生效。
Prop｜黄铜柜钥匙与红色证物夹分别建资产。三镜中，左臂始终夹住文件夹，左手压住其下缘；只有右手操作钥匙。

SHOT-01｜起点：证物夹在左腋下，钥匙在钢台上，右手空，视线看钥匙。动作：林岚用右手拿起钥匙。终点：证物夹仍在左腋下，钥匙在右手，视线转向 17 号柜。
SHOT-02｜起点：继承上镜终点。动作：她把钥匙插入 17 号柜。终点：证物夹仍在左腋下，钥匙留在锁孔，右手扶住钥匙，视线看锁孔。
SHOT-03｜起点：继承上镜终点。动作：她把钥匙转动一次。终点：证物夹仍在左腋下，钥匙已在锁孔内转过，右手仍扶钥匙，视线移到柜门缝。

提示词与参考记录：`IMG-CHAR-LINLAN`、`IMG-LOOK-LINLAN-RAIN` 只命名提示词条目。`PLAN-LINLAN-RAIN-01` 指向下方明确标为非现存文件的占位路径 `剧集/EP001/待提供/林岚雨夜造型.png`，在参考顺序中排第一，只控制身份与相容 Look，不控制手势、钥匙位置、视线或机位。现在没有真实文件被提供、检查或绑定，所以三镜都保持 PLAN，不可投产；本例不声称已获得图片、视频、人脸一致或动作效果。

可复制的纯文本交接请求：
请为 EP001 使用 `short-drama-assets`、`short-drama-image-prompts` 和 `short-drama-storyboard` 整理林岚与以上三镜；分开 Character、Look、LOCK 和镜头状态。只交文字，不生成图片、视频、配音或音乐。`剧集/EP001/待提供/林岚雨夜造型.png` 是占位路径，不是现存文件；保持 PLAN，不准备投产提交。

en: `剧集/<EP>/视觉设定.md`: the Character entry, one compatible Look, separate Props, scoped states and only the necessary continuity LOCK.
`剧集/<EP>/图片提示词.md`: copyable `IMG-*` prompt entries carrying the accepted anchors and LOCK text. They are text deliverables, not evidence of generated assets.

`剧集/<EP>/分镜.md`: `SHOT-*` state chains, frozen start frames, visual-basis references and honest `REF-*`, `PLAN-*` or missing-reference status. `视频提示词.md` is added only when the reference path is ready enough for that stage.

`剧集/<EP>/图片提示词.md`：携带身份锚点与 LOCK 锁面的可复制 `IMG-*` 提示词；它是文本交付，不证明图片已生成。
`剧集/<EP>/分镜.md`：`SHOT-*` 状态链、起点冻结帧、视觉依据，以及真实的 `REF-*`、`PLAN-*` 或缺图状态。参考路径满足该阶段要求后，才按需添加 `视频提示词.md`。

en: Editorially compare all three shots: Character anchors remain the same, the Look is compatible, the exact LOCK surface is carried wherever required, and every hand, prop and gaze at a shot start matches the preceding end.

Audit evidence labels before production: every `REF-*` resolves to an inspected real file with a stated purpose and boundary; unresolved `PLAN-*` slots stay non-production. Passing this document review does not validate or guarantee generated-media quality or continuity.
zh: 逐镜做编辑核对：Character 锚点不变，Look 内部相容，LOCK 锁面在所需位置原样出现；每镜起点的双手、持物与视线都接得上前镜终点。
投产前核对证据等级：每个 `REF-*` 都能找到已检查的真实文件，并写明用途和边界；未解决的 `PLAN-*` 继续保持不可投产。文档审阅通过不等于生成媒体质量或连续性已经验证。

title.en: Video recap editing: when to keep original sound and when to add narration
title.zh: 视频解说什么时候保留原声，什么时候加旁白？

answer.en: Let the sound that carries the event lead: an important spoken line, a switch click or a meaningful pause may need no narration. Add spoken Chinese only when it supplies supported context, a causal link or a transition that the picture and source sound cannot provide. The original radio-repair example below assigns five beats before writing one short narration block; it is an editorial illustration, not a processed video or an audio result.
answer.zh: 让真正承载事件的声音先说话：一句重要对白、开关的咔嗒声，或者有意义的停顿，都可以不加旁白。只有画面和原声不足以交代有依据的背景、因果或过渡时，再写中文解说。下面用原创的旧收音机场景，先分配五拍的声音职责，再写一小段旁白；这是编辑示例，不是已处理的视频或声音效果。

en: Start with footage you are permitted to use and an evidence index from your actual material: frames, dialogue transcription and quiet windows. The timestamps in this guide are invented examples, not safe edit points for another file.
Choose a viewer promise. Here it is “hear the change from no response to the radio sounding again,” not “prove the technician diagnosed and permanently repaired the fault.”

For setup and the complete stage sequence, use [video-to-narration](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/video-to-narration). For an already assembled timeline, use the separate [editable draft guide](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/capcut-draft).
zh: 准备获准使用的录像，以及来自实际素材的画面、对白转写与静音窗证据。本页时间戳均为虚构示例，不能直接作为另一文件的安全剪点。
先确定让观众看懂什么。本例是“听见收音机从没有响应到重新响起的变化”，不是“证明师傅诊断并永久修好了故障”。
安装和完整阶段顺序见[本地视频到中文解说](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/video-to-narration)；已有合成时间轴要继续精修，见[可编辑草稿导出](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/capcut-draft)。

en: Give each beat one leading sound

In `visual_audio_board.json`, `audio_owner` names the sound doing the main work: `original_dialogue`, `action_sound`, `ambience`, `music`, `silence` or `narration`. It is an editorial decision, not a requirement to use all six. Keep the customer’s exact line and the radio’s first sound instead of paraphrasing over both.
Write only what narration adds

A `narration_job` can be `context`, `causal_link`, `foreshadow`, `interpretation`, `transition` or `none`. In the example, the creator supplies the moving-house background; the picture does not prove it. Use that context once, then let dialogue and action carry the scene. Do not invent the customer’s motives, a diagnosed fault or an unseen repair.
Protect sentences, actions and pauses together

Keep the full line, its delivery and the reaction it causes. A switch followed by no response can own a beat; a pause is not an empty slot to fill with stock music. A rough narration-to-original-sound ratio is not a quota. Set `narration_job=none` when another sound already does the work.
Use the right clock after cutting

The cut plan selects source-video intervals. In the orchestrated cut flow, `edited_source.mp4` is created before narration is written on output time; `clip_plan_validated.json` records both source and output intervals. Use that real mapping, not the draft arithmetic below. Full mode uses the original timeline; the older one-stage cut mapping is a different path.
Turn the audio plan into actual narration windows

The assembler does not read `audio_owner` and automatically switch tracks. Implement the decisions through the actual `narration.json` blocks, clear intervals for original sound, speech evidence and mix settings. `overlaps_speech` describes overlap; setting it false does not mute the source or guarantee a quiet slot. Check where source sound returns: ducking may continue until a safe pause, or to the timeline end when no reliable release anchor exists.
Shorten words before stealing the next line’s time

A six-second picture does not require six seconds of speech. Leave room for the narration to end and source audio to recover before the next important line. If speech cannot safely fit after bounded speed adjustment, the placement can report `no_safe_fit`; it does not cut off the ending to make a successful result. Shorten, split the task or move the block and re-create the affected voiceover.
Keep captions faithful to what can actually be heard

If supplying `original_subtitles.json`, use output time and only actual original dialogue that remains audible. Do not add subtitles for deleted or covered speech. After assembly, listen to the complete handoff, not just the narration WAV; an editorial plan or subtitle file is not proof that a line survives the final mix.
zh: 先给每拍一个主要声音职责

在 `visual_audio_board.json` 中，用 `audio_owner` 指明主要承载信息的是原声对白 `original_dialogue`、动作声 `action_sound`、环境声 `ambience`、音乐 `music`、沉默 `silence`，还是旁白 `narration`。这是编导决定，不要求六种都用。本例保留顾客的原话和收音机第一次响起的声音，不在它们上面重新概括一遍。
只写旁白真正增加的信息
`narration_job` 可以是背景 `context`、因果连接 `causal_link`、伏笔 `foreshadow`、有依据的解释 `interpretation`、过渡 `transition` 或不需要旁白 `none`。本例“搬家”的背景由创作者提供，不是画面证明。交代一次就够，之后交还给对白和动作；不虚构动机、故障诊断或镜头没拍到的维修。
把完整句子、动作和停顿一起留下
留下整句原话、说话的表演和引发的反应。拨开关后没有响声，本身就能占一拍；停顿不是等待通用 BGM 填满的空档。旁白与原声的粗略比例不是硬配额，其他声音已经完成任务时，用 `narration_job=none`。
剪完以后，换到正确的时钟
剪辑计划选择的是原片区间。编排式 cut 流程先生成 `edited_source.mp4`，再按成片输出时间写旁白；`clip_plan_validated.json` 同时记录原片与输出区间。真正写稿时读取这份映射，不照抄下表的草拟加法。full 模式沿用原片时间，旧版单阶段 cut 映射则是另一条路径。
让声音方案落实到实际旁白窗口
合成器不会读取 `audio_owner` 自动切音轨。需要通过真实的 `narration.json` 段落、原声留白、对白证据与混音设置落实。`overlaps_speech` 描述是否重叠，不是把它设为 false 就能静音原片或保证那里无对白。还要看原声何时恢复：旁白结束后可能继续压低至安全停顿，没有可靠恢复锚点时甚至保持到时间线末尾。
先减字，不抢下一句原声的时间
六秒画面不代表要说满六秒。让旁白在下一句重要原话之前结束，并留出原声恢复空间。受限变速后仍放不下时，放置阶段可报告 `no_safe_fit`，不会剪掉尾音伪装成功；应缩短、拆分任务或换窗口，再重做受影响的配音。
字幕只跟随真正听得到的话
如提供 `original_subtitles.json`，使用输出时间，只写成片中仍能听见的原声对白；已经剪掉或被旁白覆盖的句子不要照样上字幕。合成后听完整交接，不只听旁白 WAV；有声音方案或字幕文件，不等于台词已经在最终混音里保住。

example.en:
ORIGINAL EDITORIAL EXAMPLE — The Radio After the Move
No source file, ASR transcript, voiceover or finished video was generated here.
All clips and timestamps below are invented planning examples, not importable JSON.

Creator-supplied context: Lao Zhou kept this old radio rather than replacing it
when he moved house. This background is not visible evidence from a frame.
Illustrated observations: a switch produces no sound; the technician reseats
a connector; radio noise then becomes audible.
No shot opens the case or establishes a permanent repair or exact fault diagnosis.

Five-beat draft cut — source clock -> provisional output clock:
1. 00:12–00:18 -> 00:00–00:06 | radio on the bench, no dialogue
   Owner: narration. Job: context.
   Chinese narration: “搬家时，老周没舍得换掉这台收音机。”
   Reading gloss only: “When he moved, Lao Zhou could not bring himself to replace
   this radio.” Do not send the English gloss to the Chinese voiceover.
2. 00:42–00:47 -> 00:06–00:11 | Lao Zhou speaks
   Owner: original_dialogue. Job: none. Preserve the complete Chinese line:
   “早上还响着，搬过来就没声了。” (It worked this morning; after the move, nothing.)
   No narration over the line.
3. 01:10–01:14 -> 00:11–00:15 | switch click, then no radio response
   Owner: silence. Job: none. Preserve the opening click and then the wait;
   the pause is this beat’s main event, not an instruction to mute the source.
   Do not add “he turns the switch” narration or music to erase the wait.
4. 01:28–01:34 -> 00:15–00:21 | connector seated, first radio noise
   Owner: action_sound. Job: none. Let viewers hear the change.
   The image and sound do not establish the whole repair history.
5. 01:52–01:58 -> 00:21–00:27 | Lao Zhou reacts
   Owner: original_dialogue. Job: none. Preserve his complete line:
   “还以为它也不肯跟我走了。” (I thought it did not want to move with me either.)
   Let the reaction finish; do not append an unsupported moral.

Avoid this invented explanation:
“The technician immediately knew the internal circuit had failed. He opened the
case and repaired it.” Neither the diagnosis nor opening the case is established.
A useful replacement is the one context line above, then room for the original sound.

Timing note: beat 1 contains six seconds of picture, not a guaranteed six-second
speech slot. The actual TTS must finish with a safe source-audio recovery window
before beat 2. The row boundaries above do not prove real pauses or safe cut points.

Text-only handoff to an agent with Video Recap Skills configured:
Use the authorized source and its actual evidence, not these illustrative times.
Prepare the story/audio board and a provisional cut plan around the five units.
Let the click lead into its pause. Keep the two full lines
and the radio’s first sound, use only the confirmed moving-house context, and
leave other units without narration. Stop at the editorial handoff: do not call
TTS, render media or add BGM. List unresolved sound/timing evidence. After I choose
the edit and the cut exists, use the validated output-time mapping for narration.
example.zh:
原创编辑示例——《搬家后的收音机》
这里没有生成源文件、ASR 转写、配音或成片。
以下片段与时间均为虚构的编辑示意，不是可导入的 JSON。

创作者提供的背景：老周搬家时没舍得换掉这台旧收音机。
这不是某一帧能证明的事实，须明确来自创作者上下文。
示意中能观察到的事：拨开关后没有响声；师傅重新插接连接头；随后有收音机杂音。
画面没有拆开机壳，也没有证明故障诊断或永久修复。

五段草拟剪辑——原片时间 → 暂拟输出时间：
1. 00:12–00:18 → 00:00–00:06｜台上的收音机，无对白。
   主职责：narration；任务：context。
   旁白：“搬家时，老周没舍得换掉这台收音机。”
2. 00:42–00:47 → 00:06–00:11｜老周开口。
   主职责：original_dialogue；任务：none。完整保留原话：
   “早上还响着，搬过来就没声了。”不铺旁白。
3. 01:10–01:14 → 00:11–00:15｜开关咔嗒，收音机没有响应。
   主职责：silence；任务：none。保留起始的咔嗒声和随后的等待；
   这一拍由停顿主导，不是要求静音原片。不要加“他拨动开关”的旁白或音乐。
4. 01:28–01:34 → 00:15–00:21｜重新插接后，收音机第一次响起杂音。
   主职责：action_sound；任务：none。让观众听见变化，
   不把这一刻扩写成已经证明的完整维修过程。
5. 01:52–01:58 → 00:21–00:27｜老周的反应。
   主职责：original_dialogue；任务：none。完整保留：
   “还以为它也不肯跟我走了。”让反应结束，不追加无依据的升华。

不该写的解释：
“师傅一眼就看出内部电路坏了，拆开机壳便把它修好了。”
素材没有证明这个诊断，也没拍到开壳。更合适的替换是上面那一句背景，
然后把声音位置交还给原话、开关声和停顿。

时间说明：第一段有六秒画面，不等于一定有六秒的朗读窗口。
真实配音要在第二段原话前收住，并留下安全的原声恢复空间。
表中边界不证明真实文件在这些位置有停顿，也不证明剪点安全。

交给已配置 Video Recap Skills 的 Agent 的纯文字请求：
使用我获准使用的源片和真实证据，不照抄示例时间。
按以上五段准备故事/声音方案与初步剪辑计划，保留开关声引出的停顿。
完整保留两句原话与收音机首次响起的声音，只使用已确认的搬家背景，其他段不铺旁白。
停在编辑交接，不调用 TTS、不渲染媒体、不添加 BGM；列出未确定的声音和时间证据。
等我选定剪法、剪后文件真实存在，再用校正后的输出时间映射写旁白。

en: `recap_story_plan.json` and `visual_audio_board.json`: the audience promise, changing beats, source evidence and leading sound. They record decisions; they are not a finished mix.

For cut, `clip_plan.json` expresses source selections; the later `clip_plan_validated.json` and `edited_source.mp4` establish the actual edited timeline. Do not relabel a draft table as an executed cut.

`narration.json`: only the required spoken blocks on the appropriate clock; optionally `original_subtitles.json` for audible original dialogue on output time. Voice files and a rendered result exist only after their stages run.

For manual finishing after a real `timeline.json` exists, use [JianYing / CapCut draft export](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/capcut-draft). Exporting a draft does not itself check that every dialogue handoff sounds right.
zh: `recap_story_plan.json` 与 `visual_audio_board.json`：记录观众承诺、变化节拍、来源证据与主要声音职责；它们是决定，不是成品混音。
cut 模式的 `clip_plan.json` 表达原片选段；后续真实的 `clip_plan_validated.json` 与 `edited_source.mp4` 才确立剪后时间线。不能把草拟表改名当成已执行剪辑。
`narration.json`：只写确有需要的口播段，并用对应时钟；`original_subtitles.json` 按需记录输出时间上仍可听到的原话。配音文件和成片必须等相应阶段实际执行后才存在。
真实 `timeline.json` 已存在、还需人工精修时，可走[剪映 / CapCut 草稿导出](https://zenstory.ai/video-recap/capcut-draft)。导出草稿本身不会证明所有声音交接都自然。

en: Listen for the intended handoff: context ends, the complete original line becomes audible, the switch click and waiting survive, and the closing line is not clipped. A label in the board cannot prove any of this.

The workflow may duck source audio around narration and delay restoration to safe anchors. Do not promise that every sound outside the written narration block is untouched; inspect the actual mix and revise the affected placement or finish it in the editor.

No real video, transcription, TTS, music, media generation or playback was performed for this editorial example. Model/media services and source permissions belong to the actual project; this guide does not guarantee an automatic best mix or a fixed narration ratio.
zh: 听实际交接：背景旁白结束后，整句原话是否清楚；开关声与等待是否保住；收尾原句是否被截断。board 中写对标签不能证明这些已经发生。
工作流可能在旁白附近压低原声，并延迟到安全锚点才恢复。不能保证书面旁白区间以外的每个声音都原封不动；要听实际混音，调整受影响的放置，或在编辑器内精修。

title.en: Keep a long novel consistent: character knowledge, promises and unresolved clues
title.zh: AI 写长篇怎样少崩人设、少忘伏笔：把已知、承诺和线索分开

answer.en: Before continuing, separate what is true in the story, what each character knows and what the reader has actually seen. Carry forward the relevant current state and unfinished commitments, not the whole conversation. Oh Story stores this handoff in project files and a structured tracking workflow. The original three-chapter example below shows how to use it without turning a future plan into an event that already happened; it is not a claim of error-free writing over hundreds of chapters. An optional continuation design also separates a visible clue from a plausible misreading, prepares the source of later evidence and gives a reveal consequences without resetting the deadline.
answer.zh: 续写前，先分清故事里真正发生了什么、每个角色知道什么，以及读者已经看到什么。带上本章相关的当前状态与未完承诺，不要只靠整段聊天“记住一切”。Oh Story 用项目文件和结构化追踪流程承接这些信息。下面用原创三章示例说明怎样使用，尤其不把未来计划当成已发生的事实；这不代表已证明连续几百章都不会出错。 另附一条可选续段设计：分开可见线索与合理误读，提前安排后续证据的来源，让揭晓产生后果，而不重置期限。

en: Use the same book project, with its actual completed chapters and tracking state. If an older manuscript has not yet become a continuable project, start with [import and continuation](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/import-and-continue). This guide is about maintaining an existing book, not importing it again.
Keep the chapter being planned, the last completed chapter and any partial draft distinct. In the example only chapters 1–2 are established; chapter 3 is still a proposal.
Provide author-only decisions explicitly. A private answer can guide the author without becoming character knowledge; an unsupported guess from the model should remain unresolved.
zh: 使用同一个书名目录、实际完成的正文与追踪状态。旧书还没有变成可续写工程时，先看[导入与接续指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/import-and-continue)。本页处理已在写的书，不要求反复重新导入。
分开正在规划的章节、最后完成章与残稿。以下示例只有第1—2章内容已经成立，第3章仍是计划。
明确提供作者私下确定的设定。作者可以知道答案，但角色不因此自动知道；模型从片段猜出的解释，应继续列为未定。

en: Separate identity from the latest state

Read the relevant `设定/角色/{角色名}.md` for stable characterization and `追踪/角色状态/{角色名}.md` for current location, goal, relationships, knowledge and open threads. “Xu Tang has an older brother” does not mean she knows he sent this letter. A returning character needs the latest state, not an old introduction copied into the prompt.
Use three information perspectives

For each important secret, ask separately: what is the author-confirmed truth, what can each character act on now, and what has the reader been shown? The tracking transaction distinguishes `objective_fact` from `reader_knowledge`; character knowledge has its own snapshot. Neither an author-only answer nor a planned reveal should silently appear in the current viewpoint.
Carry a small, relevant handoff

The continuation workflow checks the committed chapter, reads `追踪/上下文.md`, this chapter’s blueprint and the relevant outline/character material. The context card includes current position, long-term constraints, character state, active clues, recent chapters, next-chapter commitments and continuity risks. Query older material when needed rather than loading every chapter log. These are required workflow steps, not a guarantee that every host always follows them.
Distinguish a story promise from the next writing task

Xu Tang’s promise to deliver the letter before seven is an unresolved story obligation with a deadline. The chapter-3 handoff is to find a checkable old address without revealing the sender. A future chapter-4 reveal belongs in the plan; it is not already delivered knowledge. Use `next_chapter_commitments` for what the next chapter must carry, not as a permanent dumping ground for every plan or character vow.
Separate the open question, the clue and a possible reading

“Will she deliver the letter before seven?” creates an expectation about a future action. The blue triangle is an observed detail whose meaning may matter later. “The clerk is hiding the sender” is one possible interpretation, not an observed fact. For this limited-viewpoint example, preserve the visible detail while leaving room to revise the interpretation; do not label it a secret sign in neutral narration and later pretend that certainty belonged only to the reader. The bundled suspense reference distinguishes questions and planted clues; these editorial distinctions are not new tracking fields.
Let evidence change knowledge before recording a payoff

Finding a blue mark is not the same as knowing what it means. Before declaring a clue resolved, show who obtained what evidence and which uncertainty it actually closes. After the chapter is written, have the existing chapter transaction update the result, affected character snapshots, clue state and reader knowledge to match the prose. Do not write a planned discovery into tracking as if the scene already exists.
Make the answer change the next decision

A useful local payoff can settle one question while leaving another alive. In the proposed extension, a matching record can explain the triangle and identify the sender, but the delivery is still unfinished and the clock has advanced. The new address gives Xu Tang a route to choose, not a magically completed promise. This is a design option rather than a mandatory surprise or chapter-count rule. If the answer changes nothing in this story’s action, relationship or expectation, decide why it needs this much buildup.
Keep one tracking authority

`追踪/_tracking-state.json` is the structured authority. `上下文.md`, character snapshots, clue views and author/reader timelines are derived outputs, not extra places to hand-edit the story. The workflow submits one structured transaction through `tracking_commit.py`; ask the agent to show the resulting handoff, not just reply “I will remember.” The illustrative card below is not a replacement schema or import payload.
Repair old-chapter changes through their consequences

If you remove or change the clue in chapter X, request a scoped chapter revision with the intended fact and affected passage. The documented revision path recalculates tracking from X through the last written chapter and identifies later prose that may depend on it. It does not automatically rewrite every later chapter. Preserve current work before a large revision and decide which dependent passages should change.
zh: 把稳定人设与最新状态分开
用相关的 `设定/角色/{角色名}.md` 理解稳定人设，用 `追踪/角色状态/{角色名}.md` 看当前位置、目标、关系、本人已知和未结事项。“许棠有一个哥哥”，不等于她知道这封信就是哥哥寄的。久别后重新出场的人物，需要最新状态，不是重贴第一次出场简介。
把信息分成三个视角
每个重要秘密都分别问：作者已经确定的真相是什么；各角色现在能据此行动的事实是什么；读者已经看见什么？追踪事务区分 `objective_fact` 与 `reader_knowledge`，角色认知则在各自快照中。作者私下的答案与未来揭示计划，都不能悄悄变成本章视角人物的已知。
续章只带必要交接
续写流程先核对已提交章，再读 `追踪/上下文.md`、本章细纲与相关卷纲/人物材料。状态卡包含当前位置、长期约束、核心角色状态、活跃伏笔、近章速记、下一章承诺和连贯性风险；旧信息不够时再定点查，不默认读完所有逐章记录。这是流程要求，不是所有宿主都会自动正确执行的保证。
分清角色的承诺与下一章的任务
许棠“七点前把信送到”的话，是有期限、尚未兑现的故事责任；第3章的交接任务则是找到可核对的旧地址，同时不揭寄信人。计划第4章揭晓的事应留在规划里，不能算已经交付的信息。`next_chapter_commitments` 用于下一章必须承接的内容，不是把所有远期计划和角色誓言永远堆进去。
分开悬而未决的问题、线索与可选读法
“她能否七点前送到？”让人期待一个未来行动的结果；蓝色三角是已观察到、含义可能在后面起作用的细节；“登记员在隐瞒寄信人”则只是一种解释，不是已经看到的事实。在这个有限视角示例中，保留可见细节，让解释可以被新证据修正，不要先由中性叙述断言“秘密记号”，再假装这个确定判断只是读者的误会。随包悬念参考区分疑问与伏笔；这里的编辑性区分不是新增追踪字段。
先有证据改变认知，再记回收
看见蓝色三角，不等于已经知道它是什么意思。宣布伏笔回收前，要在正文中交代谁拿到什么证据，以及它究竟解决了哪个疑问。章节实际写成后，由既有章后事务更新结果、受影响角色快照、伏笔状态与读者认知，并与正文一致；不能把计划中的发现提前登记成发生过的场景。
让答案改变下一次决定
一次局部兑现可以回答一个问题，同时保留另一个问题。拟议续段中，能对应上的记录可以解释三角并指出寄信人，但送信仍未完成，时间也已流逝。新地址让许棠有路线可选，不会神奇地把承诺改成已完成。这是一种设计选项，不是强制反转或固定章节数公式。如果答案不改变本书的行动、关系或期待，就要决定为何值得如此铺垫。
只保留一个追踪权威
`追踪/_tracking-state.json` 是结构化权威；`上下文.md`、角色快照、伏笔视图和作者/读者时间线都是派生产物，不是另外几处可以手改剧情的地方。流程通过 `tracking_commit.py` 提交一次结构化事务；要求 Agent 展示更新后的交接，不要只得到“我记住了”。下面的示意卡不是替代 schema，也不是可导入事务。
旧章变动要顺着后果修
删除或改变第 X 章线索时，带着原段落和希望保留的事实请求范围明确的大修。文档规定从 X 章重算到最后已写章的追踪状态，并列出可能依赖它的后续正文；这不会自动改写所有后文。大修前先保留当前作品，再决定哪些相关段落需要一起改。

example.en:
ORIGINAL EDITORIAL EXAMPLE — The Returned Letter
These are authored excerpts and a planning card, not an executed Oh Story project.
No tracking JSON or chapter file is supplied by this example.

Established in chapter 1, at 18:20:
Xu Tang slips an unopened returned letter into her inner pocket.
“Before seven, I will put this into Aunt Shen’s hands.”

Established in chapter 2, at 18:35:
The clerk covers the page corner with a finger.
“This page records returned items, not the sender’s name.”
Xu Tang sees a blue triangle beside the date. The envelope is still sealed in her inner pocket.

Author-only decision:
Her older brother sent the letter; the triangle relates to a changed address.
The author plans evidence-based confirmation in chapter 4, not chapter 3.
This is approved background, not a fact Xu Tang has learned or the reader has seen.

Handoff before chapter 3 — explanatory labels, not a transaction schema:
- Character knowledge: returned letter; blue triangle; sender still unconfirmed.
- Reader knowledge: the same visible facts; no reveal of the brother as sender.
- Prop/location: sealed letter remains with Xu Tang at the returns desk.
- Unfinished story obligation: deliver it to Aunt Shen before 19:00.
- Next chapter’s job: obtain a checkable old address and a next action.
- Still withheld: sender identity and the triangle’s confirmed meaning.
- Planned future event: chapter 4 confirmation; not a completed payoff now.

Bad continuation:
“Xu Tang recognized her brother’s forwarding mark. With the letter delivered,
she decided to wait for him at the pier.”
Why it breaks continuity: she gains two answers without evidence, and an undelivered
letter becomes delivered without a scene. An intention is mistaken for an event.

A permitted opening revision, not a complete chapter:
Xu Tang took out the still-sealed letter and laid it beside the register.
“Is this triangle something your office draws when a letter comes back?”
She checked the wall clock. Twenty-five minutes until seven.

If chapter 3 later establishes the old address, record that new knowledge after
the scene is actually written. The triangle can remain unresolved; finding a lead
is not proof of the sender or fulfillment of the delivery promise.

OPTIONAL CHAPTER 3–4 DESIGN — author choices for a possible continuation, not additional events already established above. This invented returns desk and its records are story-world choices, not a description of real postal procedures.

Before drafting, approve these new conditions: the fictional office keeps a separate dispatch record, retrievable by a number on the envelope; it records the sender and a change to Aunt Shen’s recipient address. The record and notation key are kept in a back archive room, so the clerk must leave the desk to look them up by envelope number. The triangle belongs to an older register’s notation that the present clerk must check rather than interpret from memory. In this branch the record is accurate and belongs to this letter. These conditions must be introduced through the scene, not treated as facts the earlier excerpts already supplied. If the story instead allows forged or mistaken records, finding a name proves only what the record says, and confirmation needs more work.

1. Chapter 2, already visible: the clerk’s finger covers a corner and a blue triangle sits beside the date. Xu Tang could suspect that the clerk is protecting someone. That suspicion may be voiced as a question; “the clerk was concealing her brother’s name” would leak an answer and assert a motive the scene has not established.
2. Chapter 3, proposed, 18:40: the clerk checks an old-address directory and gives Xu Tang an old address to verify. When asked about the triangle, the clerk says that this is an older register and its notation needs checking; this directly answers why its meaning is not being asserted yet. The clerk points out the envelope number and offers to retrieve the separate record and the old notation key. Xu Tang asks for that check, choosing to spend part of her remaining time on a verified destination rather than immediately try the old address. The clerk goes to the archive room; she waits at the desk. This prepares an evidence source and a concrete next action before the reveal, but does not yet expose the sender, the new address or the triangle’s confirmed meaning. Copying an old address is progress, not delivery.
3. Chapter 4, proposed, 18:45: the clerk returns from the archive room with that record and the old notation key. Xu Tang compares its number and recipient with the still-sealed envelope. Its recipient-address-change entry carries the same blue triangle and gives Aunt Shen’s new receiving address; the key identifies the triangle as a recipient-address-change mark. Xu Tang reads it with the clerk. The separate sender field names her brother. The record’s accuracy is an approved premise of this branch, not a general rule that paperwork is infallible. The triangle explains the recipient-address status; it does not itself encode the brother’s identity. The earlier statement that the returns page has no sender name stays true.
4. What changes: Xu Tang now has Aunt Shen’s new receiving address and, under the approved evidence conditions, a confirmed sender. The envelope remains sealed and with her at the desk. At 18:45 she has fifteen minutes, not the original twenty-five. Choose and establish a reachable route before promising success. A possible next action is to ask directions and leave for the new address; do not mark the letter delivered until a handover is actually written.

Fair misdirection versus an unsupported answer:
• Keep: a character wonders whether the covered corner hides a name, then checks instead of treating the guess as knowledge. A later view of the page can show its ordinary return fields. That can undercut the suspicion; it does not prove the clerk’s entire character or hidden motives.
• Avoid: reveal that the triangle is a private family code never available to the viewpoint or reader, or introduce an all-knowing record only in the answer paragraph. If you want either different mechanism, go back and design the earlier setup rather than claiming it was present all along.
• Do not stall with a repeated question alone. Chapter 3 obtains an old address and initiates a specific record lookup; chapter 4 changes knowledge and the available destination. The remaining delivery question can carry the next scene without inventing a fresh villain or another secret at every ending. These times illustrate elapsed time, not required chapter lengths: if the lookup does not support a meaningful chapter on its own, combine the scenes instead of padding the wait.

Planning check, not a machine-readable payload: observed detail → current interpretation → needed evidence and its prepared source → what the answer changes → what remains unresolved. Use it to discuss this one clue before drafting. Only update actual clue and reader-knowledge state after the selected scenes have been written.

Read-only handoff request for an agent in the existing book project:
Before drafting, show the actual last committed chapter and the next blueprint.
For the involved characters, separate author truth, character knowledge and reader
knowledge. List the current letter/prop state, unresolved clues, deadline and the
next chapter’s specific commitment. Identify the source chapter or author decision
for each; keep unknowns unknown. Do not draft prose or hand-edit tracking yet.
After I settle the direction, I will explicitly request the chapter.

If revising an earlier chapter:
“I am changing the blue triangle in chapter 2 to a torn corner; keep the sender
unrevealed. Show which later references and planned reveals depend on the triangle,
use the existing revision workflow for tracking, and do not rewrite later prose
outside the scope I specify.”
example.zh:
原创编辑示例——《退回来的信》
下面是为指南写的片段与规划卡，不是运行过的 Oh Story 工程。
示例不提供追踪 JSON 或真实章节文件。

第1章已经成立，18:20：
许棠把尚未拆封的退信放进内袋。
“七点前，我会把它送到沈姨手里。”

第2章已经成立，18:35：
登记员用指节挡住页角。
“这里只记退件，寄信人的名字不在这页。”
许棠看见日期旁一个蓝色三角。信仍未拆封，放在她内袋里。

作者私下确定的设定：
寄信人是她的哥哥；三角与改寄地址有关。
作者计划第4章才通过证据确认，不在第3章揭晓。
这是批准的背景，不是许棠已经获知或读者已经看到的事。

第3章之前的交接——以下是说明性标签，不是事务 schema：
- 角色已知：退信、蓝色三角；寄信人尚未确认。
- 读者已知：同样的可见事实；尚未揭示哥哥就是寄信人。
- 道具/位置：信仍封口，在许棠内袋里；她仍在退件登记台旁。
- 未完故事责任：19:00 前把信交到沈姨手中。
- 下一章任务：找到可核对的旧地址，让行动有新的方向。
- 暂不揭示：寄信人身份与三角的确定含义。
- 未来计划：第4章确认；现在不能标成已经回收。

有问题的续写：
“许棠认出，那是哥哥改寄时留下的记号。既然信已经送达，
她决定去码头等他。”
问题：没有证据就得到两个答案，又没有交信场景便把未送达改成已送达。
把计划或意图误当成已经发生的事件。

允许的开头修改，不是完整一章：
许棠取出没拆封的信，压在登记簿旁。
“这个三角，是你们收退件时画的吗？”
她看了一眼墙上的钟。离七点还有二十五分钟。

如果第3章后来确实写出了旧地址，章后再记录这项新认知。
三角仍可保持未解：找到下一条线索，不等于确认寄信人，也不等于兑现送信承诺。

第3–4章的可选设计——这是供作者选择的续段，不是上文已发生的新事实。退件柜台和记录流程属于虚构世界设计，不是在介绍真实邮政手续。

动笔前先确认新增条件：虚构柜台另存一份寄件记录，可凭信封编号查找，其中登记了寄信人及沈姨收件地址的变更。记录和旧记号说明存放在后方档案室，登记员需要离开柜台，按信封编号查找。三角属于旧簿记法，当前登记员需核对，不能凭印象解释。在这条分支中，记录真实无误，且确实对应这封信。要把这些条件通过场景介绍出来，不能假装前面片段已经交代。如果故事另有冒名或错录的可能，看到名字就只能确认“记录写了什么”，身份仍需其他依据。

1. 第2章已可见：登记员指节挡住页角，日期旁有蓝色三角。许棠可以怀疑他在护着谁，但应把这写成疑问；“登记员正在藏她哥哥的名字”会泄露答案，还断言了场景尚未证明的动机。
2. 第3章拟写，18:40：登记员查旧址目录，给许棠一个可核对的旧地址，被问到三角时，他说明这是旧簿记法，需要核对，直接回应为什么此刻还不能确定其含义；随后指出信封编号，提出调取另存记录和旧记号说明。许棠选择拿出部分剩余时间核实目的地，而不是立刻去试旧址，请求核对。登记员进入档案室，许棠留在柜台等候。先让证据来源和下一步行动进入场景，但不提前给出寄信人、新地址或三角的确定含义。抄到旧地址是进展，不是送信完成。
3. 第4章拟写，18:45：登记员从档案室带回这份记录和旧记号说明。许棠将编号、收件人与仍封口的信逐项核对。收件改址栏带着相同蓝色三角，并写有沈姨的新收件地址；说明页标明三角代表收件地址有变，许棠与登记员一起读到。另一栏寄信人写着哥哥的名字。记录准确是此分支已确认的前提，不是“纸上写了就永远可靠”的通则。三角解释收件地址状态，不直接编码哥哥身份；先前“退件这页不记寄信人”的说法仍然成立。
4. 真正变化：许棠得到沈姨的新收件地址，并在上述证据前提下确认寄信人。信仍封口，仍由她拿着，人还在柜台。18:45 距七点只剩十五分钟，不是原来的二十五分钟。先选定并写出能到达的路线，再决定能否准时送达。下一步可以是问路并出发；没有真正写到交信，不能登记为已送达。

公平误导与没有依据的答案：
• 可保留：角色怀疑挡住的页角有名字，然后核对，而不是把猜测当已知。后来翻开这一角，只看见普通退件字段，可以动摇猜测；但这不证明登记员全部品性或内心动机。
• 应避免：揭晓时才说三角是视角人物和读者此前都无从接触的家族暗号，或直到公布答案那一段才造出一份无所不知的记录。真想改用这些机制，就回到前面设计铺垫，不要声称早已存在。
• 不靠重复提问拖延：第3章拿到旧址并启动具体查找，第4章改变认知和可去的目的地。尚未完成的送信任务足以接续下一场，不必每次章末都另造反派或秘密。这些时刻示范时间连续，不规定每章长度；如果一次查找不足以支撑有意义的一章，就合并场景，不靠等候凑字数。

讨论用规划顺序，不是机器可读数据：可见细节 → 当前读法 → 需要什么证据、来源如何先出现 → 答案改变什么 → 还剩什么未解决。先用它讨论这一条线索，选中的场景真正写成后，再更新实际伏笔与读者认知状态。

给同一书稿目录中 Agent 的只读交接请求：
写正文前，先列出实际最后提交章与下一章细纲。
针对本章人物，分开作者真相、本人已知和读者已知；列出信件/道具当前状态、
未结线索、期限与下一章的具体承诺。每项标出依据章节或作者决定，未知保持未知。
暂不写正文，不手改追踪；等方向确定后，我会明确点名要写的章节。

如果要修改旧章：
“我准备把第2章的蓝色三角改成信封缺角，仍不揭寄信人。
先指出后续哪些引用和揭示计划依赖三角，追踪走已有大修流程；
后文只改我指定的范围，不自动重写整本书。”

en: A small, source-backed continuation handoff for the next chapter: current character state, relevant facts/clues, obligations and reveal limits. It supplements the actual chapter blueprint, not a new mandatory tracking file.
After a completed chapter, updated structured tracking and derived views that agree with its actual events. `追踪/上下文.md` is a current handoff, not a lossless archive of the whole novel.
For a past-chapter change, the revised prose plus a recalculated tracking state and an explicit list of potentially affected later chapters. Future manuscript edits remain separate scope decisions.
If the problem is only formulaic wording, use [prose revision](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/revise-ai-prose) instead of changing the plot ledger through a polish request.
zh: 面向下一章的小范围、有依据的续写交接：人物现状、相关事实/线索、责任与揭示边界。它配合实际细纲使用，不新增一种必需的追踪文件。
章节完成后的结构化追踪与派生视图，内容应与真正写出的事件一致。`追踪/上下文.md` 是当前交接，不是全书无损档案。
旧章变化后的修订正文、重算追踪状态，以及可能受影响后续章的明确清单。未来正文要改多少，仍是独立的范围决定。
若问题只是措辞套路，改用[局部正文修订](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/revise-ai-prose)，不要借润色请求偷偷改变剧情账本。

en: Read the proposed paragraph from the viewpoint character’s position: did they obtain the knowledge they use, are props and location consistent, and has a promised action really occurred? Correct these before accepting a smoother sentence.
A chapter can advance a clue without resolving it. A planning date, a future reveal number or a successful state check does not prove that the reader has received the payoff.

For a planned payoff, can you point to an earlier observed detail, a prepared way to check it and the decision that changes after the answer? Keep a character’s mistaken interpretation distinct from established narration. Use the [fiction-analysis exercise](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/learn-from-fiction) when you need to separate text evidence from your reading; neither exercise proves how real readers will respond.

The cited workflow makes state explicit and describes transactional updates; it does not certify characterization, voice, suspense or accuracy over 100+ chapters. No model writing, tracking transaction or long-run benchmark was executed for this editorial example.
zh: 站在视角人物的位置读拟写段落：他是否真的获得了所用的信息，道具与位置是否接得上，承诺中的行动是否已经发生？句子更顺之前，先修这些问题。
一章可以推进线索而不回收。未来揭示章号、规划日期或状态检查通过，都不能证明读者已经拿到兑现。
规划回收时，能否指出先前可见的细节、已经安排的核对途径，以及答案之后改变的决定？把角色的误读与叙述已确立的事实分开。需要练习分辨文本证据和自己读法时，可看[小说精读示例](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/learn-from-fiction)；两种练习都不证明真实读者一定如何反应。
所引流程让状态显式化，并规定事务更新；它不认证人设、文风、悬念效果或连续100多章的准确率。本编辑示例没有执行模型写作、追踪事务或长程基准测试。

title.en: From outline to chapter: turn plot specifications into visible change
title.zh: 有章纲却只会复述设定？把剧情规格写成可见变化

answer.en: Treat a chapter outline as a specification for what must change, not as prose waiting to be expanded field by field. Convert its goal, obstacle, evidence, choice, cost and ending into actions the viewpoint character can perceive. The chapter may interleave beats that share a time and place, but it must preserve approved facts and release boundaries. The original library example below is an original editorial design with facts fixed for this walkthrough, not a recorded Oh Story run or a claim about model quality.
answer.zh: 章纲是“本章必须发生什么”的剧情规格，不是逐栏扩写的正文。把目标、阻碍、证据、选择、代价和章尾变化转换成视角人物可见的行动与结果；同一时空可穿插情节点，但要守住批准事实与释放边界。下面是预先约定设定的原创编辑示例，不是 Oh Story 工具实测。

en: Use a project and manuscript you own or are authorized to edit. Mark established facts, author-approved additions, unresolved questions and information that must not be revealed yet.

Choose one chapter and state its job in before-and-after terms: what the viewpoint character wants, what blocks them, and which risk, information, relationship, resource, decision or action is different at the end.

If this book was imported, review its reconstructed plan first with the [import and continuation guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/import-and-continue). For cross-chapter knowledge and tracking boundaries, use [long-novel continuity](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/long-novel-continuity).
zh: 使用你拥有或获准编辑的项目。分清既定事实、作者批准的新增内容、待定问题和本章不能提前揭露的信息。
选定一章，用前后状态说明任务：人物要什么、什么挡住他，章末哪项风险、信息、关系、资源、决定或行动已经改变。
书稿刚导入时先看[导入续写指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/import-and-continue)；跨章认知与追踪边界见[长篇连续性指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/long-novel-continuity)。

en: Write the state change before expanding beats

Replace labels such as ‘conflict intensifies’ with a testable transition. State who wants what, the initial relationship or resource position, and the different position at the end. A chapter can be quiet: conditional trust, a completed handoff or one clarified responsibility may be enough if it changes the story and leaves a reason to continue.
Turn outline fields into visible carriers

Map the goal to an attempted action, the obstacle to a person, rule, space, clock or missing proof, and information to something actually seen, heard or checked. Map a relationship change to a refusal, condition, concession or handoff. Summary is useful for transitions; the problem is compressing the chapter's decisive choice and consequence into labels. Do not create one paragraph for every field or repeat the outline's wording four times because the same requirement appears in several sections.
Make evidence change the next action

Do not let narration simply announce that the protagonist understands. Show which receipt, waterline, message, object or response alters the available options. Dialogue earns its place when it changes information, strategy, power, relationship or the next move; it need not be added to satisfy a quota.
Give the choice an owned cost

Name the options the character can actually take, the evidence supporting each, who pays, and who receives any benefit. The cost can be time, responsibility, trust or an exposed resource; it need not be a catastrophe. Keep unknown motives unknown, and do not invent a betrayal merely to make the beat louder.
End on a changed situation, not a summary

Resolve one promised change and leave a concrete next problem through an action, object, line of dialogue or image. High-pressure and revelation chapters may need stronger setup and reactions. A low-pressure relationship chapter can end with a weaker hook or a stage goal; do not impose a twist, climax or confrontation on every chapter.
Request planning only and protect approved history

Say ‘outline only; no prose’ and name the exact chapter or new range. If the request touches an already locked outline or unit, the author must explicitly authorize the affected scope; otherwise list the impact and stop. Keep unplayed future plans in the outline. Do not silently write them into continuity tracking or revise completed chapters.
zh: 先写章前、章后状态
把“冲突升级”换成可核对的变化：人物的目标、起初处境与章末新处境。低压章也可用有条件的信任、一次交接或责任明确推进，不必每章强冲突。
把字段换成可见载体
目标对应动作；阻碍落到人物、规则、空间、时间或证据缺口；信息由角色看见、听见或核对；关系变化落到拒绝、条件、让步或交付。概述可作过渡，但不能把关键选择与后果全压成标签，更不能重复各栏原句。
让证据改变下一步
不要由旁白宣布“终于明白”。写清是哪张单据、哪道水痕、哪条消息或哪个物件改变选项。对白应改变信息、策略、权力、关系或下一步，不为凑比例硬加。
给选择一笔明确代价
列出可行动的选项、依据、谁付出、谁受益。代价可以是时间、责任、信任或资源暴露，不必都是灾难；未知动机继续未知，不为加压凭空写背叛。
章尾落在变化上
兑现一项变化，再以动作、物件、台词或画面留下下一步。高压、揭露章可用更强铺垫；低压关系章允许弱钩子或阶段目标，不套高潮和反转公式。
只排纲，保护已批准历史
明确“只出或修细纲，不写正文”及章节范围。触及锁定细纲或剧情单元，须由作者明确允许影响范围；否则只列影响并停下。未来规划留在大纲，不暗写追踪，也不顺手改已完成正文。

example.en:
Original editorial example with facts fixed for this walkthrough — Moving the Archive Before the Storm (not tool output)

Facts fixed for this example: Lu Yao and Cen An must move library materials before a storm. Only one cart is usable, and there is time for only one lower-risk trip before the rain intensifies; further trips remain possible at greater risk. The two candidate loads are unique local oral-history notebooks on low shelves and replaceable school readers on loan beside a leaking window. A reversed floor drain threatens the notebooks; the readers are due back Monday. Lu Yao may choose the notebooks first, but must sign responsibility for possible damage to the school books. Do not invent sabotage, a secret message or proof that either character predicted the storm.

Before — a restatement outline:
‘The storm approaches. Lu Yao and Cen An disagree over which books to move. Lu Yao chooses the oral histories, pays a price, and leaves a problem for the next chapter.’
This names goal, conflict, choice, cost and hook without showing how evidence changes a decision.

After — a scene-level chapter outline, still not prose:
- Before state: both collections are exposed; Lu Yao and Cen An disagree, and no one owns the damage decision.
- Goal/choice: decide which load receives the first, lower-risk trip; the other can still be moved later under greater risk.
- Beat 1: Cen An rolls the cart to the school readers and shows the Monday return sheet; the external obligation becomes visible.
- Beat 2: Lu Yao checks the floor drain, sees water pushing back toward the low shelves, and verifies the ‘sole original’ accession marks on the notebooks. Evidence changes the priority; nobody merely declares the answer.
- Beat 3: Lu Yao chooses the notebooks and signs the incident form for any loss to the readers. The choice buys preservation of unique records while assigning a concrete cost.
- Beat 4: Cen An stops blocking the cart and takes its rear handle. Their relationship changes from opposition to conditional cooperation, not instant agreement.
- Ending change: the first trip ends with the notebooks upstairs, while the readers remain below the leak and may still be moved next. Cen An hands Lu Yao the signed form and says the school will inspect the crates Monday. The saved resource, exposed resource and next responsibility are all visible.

A quieter version could end when Cen An conditionally yields the cart and joins the move; that relationship shift can carry the chapter without adding a broken window, accusation or surprise villain.

Copyable planning-only request for story-long-write in your configured agent host:
Revise only the unlocked chapter 12 outline; do not write prose. My authorization covers this chapter only. Preserve established events, character knowledge and unrevealed information. Do not change other outlines, completed chapters or tracking.
Replace summary labels with a goal, obstacle, observable evidence, a choice with an owned cost, and a concrete ending change. Keep the storm, one usable cart, the two material categories and the Monday return obligation. Do not add sabotage or a hidden culprit.
If chapter 12 is locked, or the revision would alter a locked plot unit, return a change proposal without modifying locked content. Keep future plans in the outline rather than recording them as events that already happened.
Return the revised outline (or the proposal if locked) and unresolved questions, then stop.
example.zh:
预先约定设定的原创编辑示例——《暴雨前搬书库》（不是工具运行结果）

本例约定事实：陆遥与岑安要在暴雨前搬图书库；只有一辆可用小车，雨势加大前只够先完成一趟低风险搬运；之后仍能抢搬，但风险更高。低架上是地方口述史唯一原始笔记；漏水窗边是周一须归还学校、可补购的读本。地漏正倒灌。陆遥若先搬笔记，须为读本可能受损签字负责。不得新增破坏者、秘密纸条或“早已预知暴雨”。

改前——复述型章纲：
“暴雨将至，两人为先搬哪类书争执。陆遥选择口述史笔记，付出代价，给下一章留下问题。”
它列出标签，却没让证据改变行动。

改后——仍是细纲，不是正文：
- 章前：两类材料都受威胁，两人意见相反，损失责任未定。
- 目标/选择：决定哪一类先完成低风险搬运；另一类之后还能抢搬，但风险更高。
- 点1：岑安把车推到读本旁，亮出周一归还单；外部义务可见。
- 点2：陆遥看到地漏回涌，再核对笔记的“唯一原件”标记；证据改变优先级。
- 点3：陆遥选择先搬笔记，并签事故表，承担读本可能受损的责任。
- 点4：岑安接过后把手；关系从阻拦变成有条件合作，不是突然和解。
- 章尾：第一趟结束，笔记已在楼上，读本仍在漏水处，下一趟风险升高。岑安交回事故表：“学校周一验箱。”保住的资源、暴露的资源与下一步责任都可见。

若是低压关系章，也可停在岑安有条件让车并加入搬运，不必硬加破窗、指控或神秘反派。

向已配置宿主中的 story-long-write 提交：
只修改第12章未锁定的细纲，不写正文。我只授权这一章范围；保留既定事件、角色认知和未揭露信息，不改其他细纲、正文或追踪。
把复述标签改成目标、阻碍、可观察证据、带代价的选择和具体章尾变化。保留上述批准事实，不新增破坏者。
若本章已锁定，或改动需要改变锁定剧情单元，先列变更方案，不改锁定内容。未来规划留在大纲，不登记成已发生事件。
交付修订细纲（已锁定时交付变更方案）与待决问题，然后停止。

en: One bounded chapter outline whose approved facts, release limits, goal, obstacle, evidence, choice, cost, relationship/resource change and ending handoff can guide later prose.
A short unresolved-questions list instead of invented motives, evidence or future events. Planning-only work should stop before prose.
An impact note when the requested change reaches locked planning or completed chapters. No tracking change is implied by drafting a future outline.
zh: 一份范围明确、能指导正文的细纲：事实边界、目标、阻碍、证据、选择、代价、状态变化和章尾交接齐全。
一份待决清单，不替作者发明动机、证据或未来事件；只排纲任务停在正文之前。
触及锁定规划或已完成章节时给出影响说明；未来细纲不等于更新追踪。

en: For every beat, point to the visible carrier and the state it changes. If deleting a paragraph leaves the goal, evidence, choice and outcome unchanged, that paragraph may only be restating the outline.
Check causality: the evidence must exist before it changes the choice; the cost must belong to someone; the ending must follow from the approved action rather than an unapproved twist.

Check scope: no prose was written, locked material was not changed without explicit authorization, and future plans were not recorded as completed continuity facts. For wording-level revision after drafting, use [the prose revision guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/revise-ai-prose).
zh: 逐点指出可见载体及状态变化。若删掉一段后目标、证据、选择和结果不变，它可能只在复述章纲。
证据须先出现再改变选择；代价有承担者；章尾来自批准行动，而不是新增反转。
确认未生成正文、未越权修改锁定内容、未把未来规划登记成事实。落笔后只改措辞，可看[具体改稿指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/revise-ai-prose)。

title.en: Keep your author voice when AI continues a novel
title.zh: AI 续写怎样保持我的文风，而不是记住另一本书的情节？

answer.en: Describe the dimensions of your voice, give a short sample you own or may use, and separate those choices from the current book’s facts. Oh Story’s documented workflow resolves the current request, book style and relevant active author preferences before generic writing advice; a sample alone does not establish a permanent preference. The useful result is a continuation that fits this narrator and scene—not copied phrases, mandatory short sentences or a claimed voice-similarity score.
answer.zh: 把文风拆成表达维度，提供自己写的或获准使用的短样本，再与本书事实分开。Oh Story 的文档流程在写作前按当前要求、本书文风和相关 active 作者偏好作裁决，通用写法补缺；仅凭一段样本，不等于确认长期习惯。目标是符合当前叙述者和场景的续写，不是搬原句、强制短句，或追求“文风相似度”分数。

en: Use your own or authorized prose. Choose a representative passage and explain which features you want to carry over; note deliberate exceptions rather than treating every sentence as a rule.
Name the current book, viewpoint, established scene facts and unrevealed information. Keep these distinct from sentence rhythm, diction, punctuation, imagery and narrative distance.

Use a configured Oh Story agent host and the intended writing workspace. Existing author memory is optional; ordinary writing can continue when no memory state exists. For chapter-to-chapter facts, see [long-novel continuity](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/long-novel-continuity).
zh: 使用自己写的或获准使用的文字。选能代表目标风格的片段，说明想沿用什么；标明有意的例外，不把每一句都当规则。
点明当前书、视角、既定场景事实和暂不揭露的信息。把它们与句子节奏、措辞、标点、意象和叙述距离分开。
在配置好的 Oh Story 宿主及目标写作工作区操作；作者记忆不是写作前提，不存在时可直接继续。跨章事实承接见[长篇连续性指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/long-novel-continuity)。

en: Ask what makes the sample yours

Name a few useful tendencies: a long observational sentence followed by a brief exchange, understated humor, close third person, or a restrained vocabulary. Explain their function here. Do not require a semicolon, metaphor or catchphrase in every paragraph.
Separate three kinds of input

Sample observations are evidence to discuss, not automatically active memory. The current book’s characters, objects, secrets and events belong to its settings and tracking. An explicit enduring preference can be recorded at the narrowest intended scope: book, genre, workflow or global. A request for this passage only should simply be followed.
Resolve conflicts by dimension

Within safety, authorization and delivery constraints, the explicit current request outranks this book’s style, which outranks applicable author-memory preferences and generic references. Resolve viewpoint, rhythm, punctuation and other dimensions separately: keep the sample’s rhythm while using this book’s third person. Lower-priority guidance fills gaps; it does not cancel an intentional long sentence merely because a default prefers short ones. Read the current book’s full 设定/文风.md when present, rather than relying only on an old summary; an absent style file does not require a placeholder.
Carry the same decision through drafting and review

Oh Story’s style_resolution is a working decision for the task, not a new permanent author profile. The documented workflow passes the same decision to downstream drafting, rewriting and review so a later pass does not restore a generic style. Intentional expression still needs readable syntax, supported character knowledge and sound causality. The query script filters stored active preferences; the writing agent applies their meaning and resolves dimensions. It is not a deterministic voice-matching engine.
Treat memory as an explicit scoped action

Repeated corrections or inferred sample patterns remain pending until confirmed; pending items do not constrain writing. An explicit long-term request uses record and returns an Author Memory Receipt. Without that receipt, do not say it has been remembered. A book-specific exception should not erase a global habit, and a one-off request should not silently rewrite either.
Revise the preference when your intention changes

Use an explicit replacement for a changed rule, or ask to forget a preference so it is no longer loaded. Forgetting does not promise deletion of historical evidence. The profile, pending list and change log are derived views of _author-memory-state.json; do not edit their Markdown to simulate a successful memory update.
zh: 先说样本哪里像你
提取少数有用倾向：观察稍长、对话简短、轻微调侃、贴近人物的第三人称，或克制的用词，并说明这次为什么要它。不要要求每段必须有分号、比喻或口头禅。
把三类输入分开
从样本观察到的模式只是待讨论证据，不自动成为 active 记忆。本书人物、道具、秘密与事件归设定和追踪；明确的长期偏好按本书、题材、流程或全局等适用范围记录。“只改这一段”则只执行，不偷偷记成习惯。
按表达维度解决冲突
在安全、授权和交付约束之内，当前明确要求优先于本书文风，再到适用的作者记忆和通用方法。视角、节奏、标点分别裁决：可以借样本的节奏，仍用本书第三人称。低优先级只补缺项，不能因默认偏好短句就剪掉作者有意保留的长句。 本书有设定/文风.md 时读全文，不只用旧摘要；没有文件也不必先建占位文件。
让写作和审稿沿用同一决定
style_resolution 是本次任务的表达裁决，不是新建永久画像。文档要求把同一裁决交给后续正文、改写与审稿，避免下一轮又套回通用风格；但有意的表达仍需语句可读、角色认知有据、因果成立。 query 脚本负责筛选已存的 active 偏好，语义上的维度裁决由写作流程中的 Agent 完成，不是确定性的文风匹配引擎。
记住偏好，要明确范围和回执
重复修改或样本推断先待确认；pending 不参与正文约束。明确的长期声明通过 record 记录，并返回 Author Memory Receipt；没有回执，不能声称已记住。本书例外不应删除全局习惯，一次性要求也不应暗改两者。
意图变了，再替换或停用
长期规则改变时明确替换；不再需要时要求忘掉，使其不再加载。“忘掉”不等于删除历史证据。画像、待确认清单与变更记录是 _author-memory-state.json 的派生视图，不手改 Markdown 冒充记忆更新。

example.en:
Original editorial example — The Last Button (not a recorded Oh Story run)

A short sample written for this guide, from a DIFFERENT story:
“After lunch, Father turned his empty bowl halfway around, as though the other side might still hold some soup; when I offered the kettle, he left it in my hand and asked whether the mint by the window needed watering again.”
Possible observations: an extended sentence, a semicolon turn, concrete observation and mild humor. These are tentative observations, not proof of an enduring preference. Father, soup, the first-person narrator and the mint plant do not belong to the new book.

Facts fixed for The Last Button:
Third person, close to Tang He. Master Zhou puts a matching dark-green button in her palm and says the repair cannot be finished today, but will be ready tomorrow morning. Tang He holds the button against the gap on her coat and checks the color. Do not add a family history, a hidden relationship or another character’s thoughts.

A plain, shorter rendition—not an incorrect draft:
“Master Zhou put the dark-green button in Tang He’s palm. ‘Not today. Come back tomorrow morning.’ She held it against the gap on her coat. The color matched.”

One alternative after the author chooses a longer rhythm and mild humor for THIS BOOK:
“Master Zhou put the dark-green button in Tang He’s palm and said the repair would have to wait until tomorrow morning; she held it against the gap on her coat, where the color matched so exactly that it was a pity buttons could not sew themselves back on.”
Both versions preserve the same actions and deadline. The second changes cadence and commentary, not the plot. It does not transplant the sample’s bowl, mint, father or first-person viewpoint. This is one editorial option, not a measured likeness or a guarantee of consistent model output.

Copyable request for story-long-write in your configured host:
Use the authorized sample only to discuss expression, not to copy sentences or transfer its story facts. Work only on the specified passage of The Last Button; preserve the fixed actions, tomorrow-morning deadline and close-third viewpoint. For this book, I want longer observational sentences and mild humor where they help; do not add them to every paragraph. First state the applicable style decisions, then return one proposed passage without changing project or memory files. Distinguish tentative sample observations from my explicit choices. Carry the same decisions into review; do not mechanically shorten the passage.

Optional SEPARATE enduring request, only if this is really your intention:
“Remember for The Last Button: allow longer observational sentences and mild humor where they help. This is a book-specific preference, not a global rule.”
This is an example request, not a receipt. No preference has been recorded by this guide. A later ‘make this one paragraph brisk and factual’ request governs that paragraph without silently replacing the book preference.
example.zh:
原创编辑示例——《最后一枚纽扣》（不是 Oh Story 运行结果）

为指南写的短样本，来自另一个故事：
“午饭过后，父亲把那只空碗转了半圈，像是换个方向就能找到还没喝完的汤；我把水壶递过去，他没有接，只问窗边那盆薄荷是不是又该浇水了。”
可讨论的观察：句子较长、分号转折、具体观察、轻微调侃。这些只是候选，不证明长期习惯。父亲、汤、第一人称和薄荷都不是新书的设定。

《最后一枚纽扣》的约定事实：
第三人称，贴近唐禾。周师傅把配好的深绿纽扣放到她掌心，说今天来不及，明早可以取。唐禾把纽扣贴在外套衣襟缺口上，核对颜色。不新增身世、隐秘关系或他人的内心。

朴素短句版——不是错稿：
“周师傅把深绿纽扣放到唐禾掌心。‘今天来不及了，明早来取。’唐禾把纽扣贴到衣襟缺口上，颜色一致。”

作者为本书选择较长节奏与轻微调侃后的一种写法：
“周师傅把那枚深绿纽扣放到唐禾掌心，说今天已经赶不及，明早可以取；她低头把纽扣贴在衣襟缺口上，颜色倒是对得一丝不差，只可惜纽扣不会自己长回去。”
两版行动和期限相同，改变的是节奏与叙述语气，不是剧情。没有搬来原样本的碗、薄荷、父亲和第一人称。这只是一种编辑选择，不是相似度成绩或稳定复现的保证。

向已配置宿主中的 story-long-write 提交：
样本是我有权使用的，只讨论表达，不复制原句或移植情节。仅处理《最后一枚纽扣》的指定段落，保留上述动作、明早期限与贴近唐禾的第三人称。本书可以用较长观察句和轻微调侃，但有用时才用，不必每段都有。
先说明本次各维度的表达决定，再给一版段落建议；不改项目文件，不写作者记忆。分清样本推测和我的明确选择，审稿沿用同一决定，不机械剪短。

确实希望长期沿用时，再单独提出：
“记住：仅《最后一枚纽扣》这本书，允许有用的较长观察句与轻微调侃，不设为全局规则。”
这是示例请求，不是记忆回执；本指南没有替你记录任何偏好。以后若说“这一段写得短促、客观”，本段按新要求写，不暗改本书长期偏好。

en: A short, task-specific account of style choices and their scope, separating explicit requests from tentative sample observations and protected story facts.
One proposed passage that preserves the specified events while making the selected cadence and narrative tone visible; neither alternative has to be universally better.
Only when explicitly requested: a scoped memory change and its actual tool receipt. Ordinary sample discussion or a one-off revision need not create author memory.
zh: 一份简短的本次表达决定，分清明确要求、样本候选观察与不可改的故事事实，并说明范围。
一版保留指定事件、体现所选节奏和语气的段落建议；不宣称某一种写法普遍更好。
只有明确请求长期记忆时，才交付对应范围的记忆变更与真实工具回执；普通样本讨论或一次改稿不必创建作者记忆。

en: Read for function, not matching words: does the voice fit this narrator and scene, without mechanically repeating a stylistic feature? Check that the sample’s names, objects and private history have not migrated into the book.
Check the scope of each decision. A current-passage exception should not replace a long-term habit; a pending inference should not appear as an active instruction or a claimed successful write.

Review clarity, viewpoint and causality as well as preference. Authorial intent does not remove genuine craft problems. For bounded wording edits, see [prose revision](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/revise-ai-prose); for missing scene movement, see [outline to chapter](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/outline-to-chapter).
zh: 看表达有没有服务叙述者和场景，不看偏好词命中率，也不机械重复某种句式。检查样本的人名、物件与隐含身世有没有混入本书。
核对每项决定的范围：本段例外不替换长期习惯，pending 推断不冒充 active 指令或成功写入。
同时看清晰度、视角与因果；作者有意选择某种表达，不意味着真实文笔问题消失。局部措辞修改见[改稿指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/revise-ai-prose)，缺少场景推进见[从章纲到章节](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/outline-to-chapter)。

en: [Dimension-level style precedence and shared decisions](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/f138f584fe543e1afe66307d8a7643b61d502d04/skills/story-long-write/references/style-resolution.md#L5-L18)
[Preference boundaries and book facts](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/f138f584fe543e1afe66307d8a7643b61d502d04/skills/story-long-write/references/author-memory.md#L3-L18)

[Derived views and task-specific active context](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/f138f584fe543e1afe66307d8a7643b61d502d04/skills/story-long-write/references/author-memory.md#L22-L49)
